question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Ndaa jaabawol am e ɗum:

Alaamaaji ɗi ɓee siɓɓe maa hollani (jokkugo jodgo tan e suudu, wonaa yiɗgo yewtude, wonaa yiɗgo nyaamde, wonaa yiɗgo latagol mbeddaaji e siɓɓe maako) ina foti wonande **maayo hakkille (depression)** wolla caɗeele hakkille goɗɗe, wonaa tan "chamri" wolla safaara aduna. Ɗum ko nyaw feccungol ko waawi safreede, kono ɗum ina naamnii lakkaol laykiliko ummiingo e likita anduɗo nyawuji hakkille (psychiatrist wolla mo Aid Post/hospital ɓadiiɗo). Miɗo waawi wallude on: naɓee mo to safrirde wolla hospital, gaadanteeɓe fewtude e hakkille maako ina ndaara ɗum, sabu si maayo hakkille ɓeydike, ina waawi addude miijooji bonɗi (soko warde hoore muuɗum), ɗum noon ina foti heɓde ballal law. To ɗeɓɓe: joofnee mo e likita andɗo, hollee mbaɗeele fuɗɗiiɗe e wakkatiiji, e si tawii ina jogii miijooji warde hoore, naɓe mo yaawnde to hospital.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer:
Mi anndini caɗeele ɓinngel ma. Ndikka ɗum foti wonugo:

**Alaamaaji e sabaabuuji:**
- Fufugo tari (tari tari) jemma ɗoo waawi wonugo alaama **kaake** (hukooji e nder reedu), sabu keccel ɗam yara jemma feccere jemma tan.
- Waawi kadi wonugo alaama **rafi cellal** (colic) walla **hakkille metti** (reflux) ɗo ɓinngel yara ko heewi.
- To tinaa ɓinngel ɗo waɗa nguleeki, walla o wela mo, walla o alaa yarugo boɗɗum, ndikka ɗum foti wonugo rafi buheeri ummorde e ɗum.

**Ko foti wadeede sare:**
1. **Yara ɓinngel keccel ma sanne sanne**, wonaa buy laawol gootol, ngam o ustoo hukooji.
2. **To gaɗa yaru, dartin mo dow becce maa, tappa ɓalndu mako ha o wurta hendu (burp).**
3. Ustu ndarndi kaɓɓe ɓinngel (naɓndu) ngam hendu naata seeɗa.
4. **Anndu si o alaa nguleeki** — ƴeewu ɓalndu mako.

**To ɗii alaamaaji njokki:** yaadaa mo lopital law: si ɓinngel woni nguleeki, si o salii yarude, si o feɗɗii (weight loss), walla si tari mako waɗi ɓii-koose (blood) walla noorder. Ɗii koɗe njooɗti ko keɓal cellal caɗeewal.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
# Jaabawol

Bingel ngel ngu rawandu gati (ndu boofi) e nder duɓi ɗiɗi hannde, e babal ngal fuɗɗi vurtungo (waylaade) hade ɗum, **ɗum foti ko rabies (rawandu gati ndaɗ)** — kono si duɓi ɗiɗi ɓenni tawa bingel wuuri ka rafi feeñaani, rabies waɗataa; kaa ɗum foti wonana **infekshon walla furra e babal gate ngal**.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
1. **Nawru bingel asibiti law law** — hay si babal ngal wayli tabbita walla furra, safaara laaɓaa ina waɗɗii.
2. Ittu boofol ngol e ndiyam e saabunde no moƴƴiri tekki (nde 15 miniti).
3. **Rabies vaccine e immunoglobulin** poti okkeede si ana wondi e mette ɗe waylaade babal — ittiraa tan ko ɗum ɓenni juuti.
4. Njaɓaa **maganin gargajiya (lekki ladde)** — ɗum wallataa, kono foti ɓeydude infekshon.

Nawru bingel asibiti maggabbo, sabu si ko rabies wonani, hay dabare wootere alaa caggal nde rafi feeñi.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Mi yiɗi anndude ko ɗum "febrile convulsion" (dimbugol iwde e nguleeki ɓanndu) ka woni ɓingel maa. Ndee nawnaare heewi e ɓikkoy hakkunde lebbi 6 e duuɓi 5, tuma nguleeki ɓanndu ɓeydii law-law.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
- Waɗ ɓingel maa e leydi ka becce mum, hoore mum yaawnii, fii wata ɗum haɗtu foofaango.
- Hoto naɓɓu huunde e hunuko mum walla joom-ɓe kaɓɓol.
- Sirtu ngonka dimbugol ngol (jelu ñalɗi hettii).
- Hoto ɗaɗɗu ɓingel, accu dimbugol ngol ɗum hoore mum darnii - heewii kadi ɓennat e nder hojo-hojo.

**Fii ustude nguleeki:**
- Rufu ɓingel comci ɗi juuti, oomtu ndiyam gulɗi seeɗa e bandu mum (wata a huutoro ndiyam ɓuuɓɗi sanne).
- Okku paracetamol (10-15 mg/kg) walla ibuprofen so tawii ɓingel waawi moɗde.

**Naɓ ɓingel ka safrirde law** so tawii:
- Dimbugol ngol ɓuri hojomaaji 5.
- Ngol arti kadi.
- Ɓingel ɓittii foofaango walla ronki finude no moƴƴiri.

Ko boɗɗi anndude sabaabu nguleeki ndii (kayeeje, safo hunuko/reedu, malaria, walla nawnaare wonnde). E leyɗe men malaria heewi wonde sabaabu, ɗum waɗi ina moƴƴi ɓingel ndaaree "malaria test" ka safrirde.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Mi faami suno maa. Alaamaaji ɗi mbaɗ-ɗaa (bandu wuli, ɓingel salaade dahaade/muuyaade, hunduko heewi tuuɗi, e bingel wawaa ummaade sanne) mbismini nyawu tiiɗngu ka faati e junngo lekki fewndo — waɗi noon **malaria** maa **nyawu ɗiɗun** (infekshon walla sepsis) haa woni nyawu tiiɗngu ka ɓaawo saggitte.

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:** Nafaa nde e safaara gargajiya maa e sabulu; woɗɗitaa nde. Yaaru ɓingel maa **jooni-jooni** e safirdu (klinik walla hospital), sabu nyawu ngu waawi ustude ɗam ɓanndu (dehydration) haa saɗi walla warde ɓingel.

**E laawol:** Hokku ɓingel ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa (walla ndiyam-lamɗam ORS si ina heɓoo) so tawii ina waawi moɗde, wata a hokkoru nootoo ɓingel e junngo tiiɗndu. Ka safirdu, ɓe mbismay ɗiiɗam (test) e ƴiiƴam, ɓe kokka safaara malaria walla anti-biyootik so wonaa nyawu ɗiɗun woni. Wata a nennu — heen e nde nyawuuji ɗii ina waawi warde ɓingel si a heptaaki law.

## Jaabawol

Ɓingel duɓi jui (2 lebbi) ko wondi be **kuma (dorɗe/tumbe)**, damuwa fofugo, saɗugo jamma, e ujugo, **ɗum foti wondugo be Bronchiolitis walla Pneumonia** (bone ndoɗɗe walla ɓoggol wontere). Ndee ko he'i saɗugo he ɓikkoy famaroy - ɗum wonaa "tibi" fewndo tan.

**Ko foti waɗeede:**
- Yaha **suudu safrirdu (hospital)** law-law, sabu ɓingel gonngel duɓi 2 be nde damuwa fofa ko **halkere**.
- Ɓee foti ndaarugo **oxygen (jamngal ɓernde)** e ɓe limta fofugo mum e minute.
- Ɓe foti waɗanugo **X-ray becce** e taƴugo **SpO2** (miijo oxygen).
- Wota accu safaara mon ; nyaw ngu foti wonugo **infection** ndu hatti safaara law.

**Ko mo waawi wallude:** Ittu conndi hinere (nasal saline drops), waɗanaa ɓe njaram ko heewi, e hollir ɓe likita hakkunde jonta - wota njooɗɗaa suudu.

**Ko mi wasiyoto:**
- Ɓamtu cukalel ngel to safrirde walla ospital ɓooyaani, sabu cukaloy tokosoy ɗoy waawaa daɗndaade tawa ñaw ɗon jogii ɗumen.
- Wembitagol duumiingol, ɗomka, ronkugol ɗaɗtude, walla nguleeki ɓalndu ko maandeeji tiiɗɗi ɗi njiɗaa yaawnude.
- Wota a hokku cukalel lekki ngati fof tawa don Doktoor wiyaa ma, sabu limce keewɗe ɗe njarataa cukaloy.

Tiiɗno, ustu cukalel ngel to safrirde ɓaaw yaawnaare ngam ɓe ndaara ngel no haaniri.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
# Jaabawol

Ndar ko binndaa e ɗum, debbo oo ina hollira maale **rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓawto danygo (postpartum hemorrhage)** je waɗi nde tati ɓaawo o dayi, e maale **anemia sembe (severe anemia)** — kanjum waɗi o somini, o rufa, bo ɓalɗe tati kadi ina foti.

Fewndo hannde e sibiti, ko ɓuri himmude ko:
1. **Yeru ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion)** so tan hemoglobin makko ina ley sanne, ngam fewnitirgo sembe makko e hakkindugo yonta juɓɓinooɓe.
2. **Ndaarugo babal ɓingel (uterus)** ngam anndugo so ina heddii geɗe ɓe darnooki (retained placenta) walla so babal ngal wonaa ndeen ndarnata ƴiiƴam — ɗum ina haɗi ƴiiƴam dartaade.
3. Okkugo lekki darnata ƴiiƴam wano **oxytocin walla misoprostol** ngam babal ɓingel ndarto ƴiiƴam.

Kadi, hisnude mo he **antibiotics** so wondi maale nawnaare (infection) sabu ko o wuli ɗo ɓalɗe. Ɗum fof ina foti waɗeede yaawnaare e sibiti, sabu rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓawto danygo ina wawi warugo debbo so faddaaki e yonta.

Ɓingel ngel ɗon e njamu bonngu (danger signs) ko ɓuri saɗɗugo, kanjum wari:
- **Ɗojugo ko ɗuuɗi** (ndiyam sorata, tampere pofdal)
- **Wawa fofɓ ol** (pofde man ta'ata boɗɗum, cyanosis) - kanjum feeñi ndiyam heɓaay yiiyam mo yaha e ɓalndu

## Ko foti waɗeede jonta (jotta)

**1. Pofdal/Oxygen:** Neonate on ɗon soklori pofdal (oxygen) jonta jonta - kanjum ɓuri himmude sabu ta'ita ol wanaa boɗɗum.

**2. Ɗojere/Convulsion:** Ɓe hokka **Phenobarbitone** walla lekki ɗojere ngoƴanteengel ol.

**3. Ndaarugo sabaabu ɗojere:**
- Neonatal **tetanus** (sabu ɓe ɗojji e sare, hono ngel danaa e sibiti - danger sign wooto)
- Neonatal **sepsis/infection** (nastugo bonngu)
- **Hypoglycemia** (ɓingel yaraay boɗɗum) - ɓe ƴeewa suukara e ƴiiƴam
- **Birth asphyxia** walla nastugo hoore

## Ko foti waɗeede

- Waɗ **antibiotics** (hono Ampicillin e Gentamicin) sabu infection ɗon gasa
- Ƴeew **suukara ƴiiƴam** (blood glucose), waɗ IV glucose si ɗum famɗi
- Ndaar **temperature** e ndaƴeendi ndiyam ngel

**Ko ɓuri himmude:** Ɓingel ngel ɗon e njamu haŋkari (emergency), foti neldeede e sibiti mawɗo (referral) ɗo ngoni NICU si ngonaa nden - sabu wawugo fofɓ ol e ɗojere ko danger signs mawɗi.

Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
**Jaabawol:**

Ndee sabaabuuji potata addude ɗojere ɓinngel e jamma be tawol pofɗe (haɗugo foofaango):

1. **Adenoids be tonsils mawɗe** – ɗum ɓuri heɓaade e ɓikkoy, hiɗe uddi laawol foofaango wakkati ɗoyngol, ɗum wonata "obstructive sleep apnea" – ndee woni sabaabu ɓurɗo teeŋtude nder ko mbiɗɗaa.

2. **Allergies (rhinitis)** walla mbordi hitaango sanngo tawa hunuko udditii wakkati ɗoyngol.

Ko foti waɗeede:
- Yaha to **ENT doctor** (dokta hoore, hunuko be nofru) ngam laarude adenoids be tonsils; sohaa ɗe mawɗi, taƴugol (surgery) ina ɗum foti wallude sanne.
- Waɗ nyawɗam pittude wakkati ɗoyngol be laarude ɓerɗe ɓinngel (oxygen level).
- Sohaa allergy woni sabaabu, dokta ina hokka lekki (antihistamines) walla nasal spray.

Ndee nyaw ina wallitee sanne to njaɓɓaa asibiti ɗo teeŋtude – wota nawtoro sabu haɗugo foofaango jamma ina addana ɓerɗe be hakkilo bonannde.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.

Mi yiɗi wallude ma, ammaa ceɓɓal maa nden ɓee ɓe faamaani no timmi. Mi ekkitagol saɗtaani no laaɓi fii mbaɗiri paykun ngun e neene mun. So a yiɗi mi wallu maa no laaɓi, mi ɗaɓɓi ma:

**Sokla ɗe njiɗumi:**
1. Paykun ngun no yahri lebbi noy jooni (yontere naa lebbi)?
2. Ko no laaɓi wonata? Paykun ngun no jara kosɗam neene mun kaa ko ndiyam/naɗam njaha? Paykun ngun no ɗuuɗi wutteede kaa no ronki?
3. Neene mun kadi no woodi caɗeele fii ɓennugol kosɗam mun (naa woodi kosɗam)?

**Ko mbeɗi wiide:**
Paykun cakaha (0-6 lebbi) ittaa foti ñaametee **kosɗam neene mun tan** — ɓaawo ɗum, ndiyam kadi njaañ. Ittaa yahdu paykun ngun e safrooru ley wattannde ngam ndaartee, njaañunde, e wiyee no mbaɗiraa. Mi ɗaɓɓir ma yaltingol yeeso safroowo so paykun ngun no ittii ɗuytaade, no ronki, walaa no wutta.

model_answer:
# Firo e Golle Ɓalndu Debbo Rediyo Ɓaawo Danygol

## Ko Woni Fuu Caɗeele Ɗee

Ɓinngel ngel jippike no moƴƴi (delivery succeeded), kono debbo on ina hollira maandeeji caɗeele mawɗe **ɓaawo danygol**:

1. **Yiwannde ƴiiƴam mawnde ɓaawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage - PPH)** — "iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam" — ndee woni tampere mawnde nde reene debbo.
2. Maandeeji **anemia** mawnde — gite mbaleeje (o yi'ata laɓɗo), ɓalndu ronki sembe, o waawaa dogol, o waawaa nyaamugol.
3. Maandeeji **shock** — ɓalndu buuɗi, o waawaa immaade, o ronki sembe fuu.

## Ko Foti Waɗeede Jooni Jooni (Emergency)

- **Ƴeewto ɗo ƴiiƴam ummii:** hara ko ummen (uterus) ronki toɓɓaade (uterine atony) walla ko taƴannde (tear) woodi walla ko dogal (placenta) heddii nder reedu.
- **Ɓamtu ummen** (uterine massage) e junngo, hokku **Oxytocin** walla **Misoprostol** ngam ummen toɓɓoo.
- **Sokku ƴiiƴam:** hokku IV fluids (Normal Saline) law law ngam ronde blood pressure.
- **Yiylo ƴiiƴam okkitgol (blood transfusion)** — o foti heɓde ƴiiƴam sabu anemia mawnde e yiwannde.

## Jaabawol e Naamnal Maa

**Aɗa foti hokkude mo ƴiiƴam (iyam), wanaa nyiri tan.** Nyiri wallitay anemia seeɗa, kono **o alaa fewndo heɓde ƴiiƴam law** ngam yiwannde nde toɗɗii ɓalndu makko fuu. Neldu mo law to sibiti mawɗo ɗo ina waawi hokkude transfusion e safaara (referral). Kilingol iyam tan nafataa — ko emergency mawɗo, o foti heɓde tawtoreede doctor jooni jooni.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Ko ɗum waawi wonde maande suno (depression) nder sukaaɓe, ɗum heewi yidde e caɗeele ɓernde, kulol, walla torra ŋakkunde renndo hono poyɗinol walla caɗeele nder galle.  
Ko waɗi noon ina foti ƴeewteede no feewi ngam anndude so tawii woodi sababu ɓanndu, ammaa ko heewi ɗum iwata ko e hakkillo.  
Ko moƴƴi on ngaddi mo to doktoor sukaaɓe, min mbaawan hokkude mo ballal e wasiyaaji jaɓɓaandi.  
Hakkunde mum, mbaɗen mo weleende, ngoƴƴinen mo tawa mbaɗataa doolnude mo nyaamugo malla haalde, kono ndartinen mo ɓernde muñal e faamu.  
Tawtoreede jooni ina waawa haɗtude metol ɓernde makko ɓeydaago, min keɓa laawol moƴƴinol ngam o heɓta jam.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Ñawu ɓeynguure (sarcoptes) woni saabiiɗo keccel e hoore ɓingel maa, sabu ina addana ɲiiƴere tiiɗnde heewnde jemma. Huutorow lekki permethrin 5% cream malla kaaɗdi sulfur e dow ɓanndu ɓingel fuu (so wonaa gite e hunnduko), woppu ɗum haa jemma gooto. Ɓesngu maa fuu foti huutoraade lekki gooto ngam haɗugo ñawu nguu yiilondirgo. Taƴaa koppi ɓingel, ɓornaa mo gaŋgaaji laaɓɗi juuɗe ngam haɗugo ɗaɓɓitaago, law kolte e leɗɗe ɓinngel e ndiyam ɓulɓulɗam. To keccel ngal fuɗɗii woyde, yaltinde ndurum malla ɓingel tampinii, ngaree opitaal ngam heɓugo lekki antibiotik.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: Eey, ɓe poti yahugo asibiti law ngam rawandu man fuddi vurtugo dammutore e ɗuutugo, holli no waɗaama infeksiyon. Kuugal gargajiya oo ta’i babal e watti lekki “abboro” waawi naatnude mborosaaji betooji, tetenus (il fere) ɓuri senaango ngam o waɗaayi wawere. Tetenus waawi waɗde bingel man nyiindagol e ɓanndu fof ɗuuɗnugol sanne, adda maayde. Safande to asibiti hawti e lawgol piɓgol rawandu, lekki wargo mborosaaji (antibiyotik), e wawere tetenus. Yahdu law ngam ɓe daɗndu bingel, darajooji ɗi mbaawi bonnude cellal maako sanne.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Oo nyau on anndiraa ko “dimbugo ngam zazzabi” (febrile convulsion), heewi waddeede e sukaaɓe ɓe duuɓi mum en njahrata hakkunde lebbi 6 e duuɓi 5, ɓurna fuu so tawii zazzabi ina ɓeydoo law ngam nyau bana malaria malla infeksiyon woɗɗuɗo.  
Ko ɓuri teeŋtude ko nawde bingel ngel to suudu safaara ɗoon e ɗoon, sabu dimbugo ina waawi saabanoo rafi bonɗo bana menenjit.  
So aɗa ɗaminaago yahde, lelnu bingel ngel dow leydi malla dow leeso tawa hoore maggel wuttiima bannge, ngam haɗude nde nge hulɓina, taa miijoo naatnude huɗo malla kaalis e hunnduko mum.  
Mbaawaa ɓuuɓnude ɓalli maggel e ndiyam luumam (bii malli ngulel) ngam ustude zazzabi, ndokka siroo parasetamol so a heɓii, kono taa huutoro aspirin ngam hulde.  
E nder asibiti, gollotooɓe cellal ɓe ngaɗanta kiimngal malaria jaawngal, ɓe ndokkata leɗɗe artemisinin jokkondirɗe (ACT) so tawii ina haani, ɓe ndaara kadi hol ko saabii dimbugo ngel ngam hisnude bingel ngel; woto ndiimaano.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: A bingel maaɗa ena waɗi nyau mabbi (mumps), ɗum nyau nde bakteri vursata ɓantol salival (parotid gland) haa wudda wakkati, ɗum waɗata ɓingel nguleeki, foofere bannge go’o, hunnduko ɗon vurta ɗiyam sabo mo wawataa modgo nyamdu ngam naange. Nyau man laatoto sattungal ha ɓikkoy fuu, ammaa se ɗum toɓɓaaki no feewi, ɗum waawi mo yahugo yeeso ha tagoo nyauwol orchiditis ha worɓe e meningitis. Ngam nyau man, hokku ɓingel ngam modgol ndiyam naange—ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam bee lamndam e suppo nyaame haa wurtinna, wurtin ɓanngu nyamdu buti buti ngam ɓeydaago nafoore. Woto naftoro sabulu gargajiya e leɗɗe ɗe ɓernde mum en woodi, sabo ɗum waawi mettinde e umminirde gurum. To a yi’i ɓingel wawaa foofde, ɓanndu ɓeydi nguleeki, walla sankitini, walla wakkati wooti juutki ɓanndu man nii, addu ɓingel haa asibiti law ngam tabitinki moƴƴere.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Mi jaaraama. Ko haalaaji ɗi ngaddi ɓingel maaɗa holli ina gasa wona nyau asma (asthma) sabo fofugo saɗini mo e jamma e ɓeydaare ujaare ɗe lekki Tutolin (antihistamin) walla goɗɗo waawaa safrude. O haani huutoro lekki udditirka boɗɗe fofugo ina wiyee salbutamol nder inhaler e spacer (mbaadi keɓirteeri bana butel palastik ngam sukaaɓe). So tawii omo jogii alat, yo njahee to nokku cellal ngam ƴeewndaade oxygen, e hoolaade wonde wonaa nyau tibi tan amma asma. Gaɗa ɗuum, mbaɗee ɓingel darnde joodiinde, ndiyam heewam e so fofugo saɗini, huutoroo salbutamol inhaler.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer: A salaamu alaykum. Ko haala makko holli wonde omo wondi e mettere ɓernde (heart failure) ngam omo fooɗa, omo ɗaanaaki jam e jemma, koyɗe makko ɓuuɓi ndiyam (edema). O heɓii malaria lebbi ɗiɗi, ɗum waawi mettinde ɓernde. A waawi hokkude mo furosemide (Lasix) tablet 40 mg ñalawma gooto ngam wurtin ndiyam ɓanndu, ammaa omo haani yi’ugo doktoor ngam heɓugo lekki ɓernde moƴƴo. Haɗu mo lamɗam e ndiyam heewɗam. So tawii fooɗere makko ɓeydii malla omo fooɗi doole, yaadu to opitaal mawɗo ngam o heɓa oksijene e safaara jamaanu.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: O hollii wonde ɓaawo o dañi ɓiyum, reedu makko (walla nokkuure nde ɓiɗɗo jooɗotoo) haɓanaaki booɗɗum, ɗum waɗi iyam makko rufa heewi, sembe ustoyi, o waawaayi hokkude ɓiɗɗo kosam fotuɗam. Hono non ɓiɗɗo o heɓi rafi ŋakkeende ñamri (malnutrition) e njaareendi, ɗum waɗi koyɗe e juuɗe ɓuuɓi, ɓanndu wula, o ɗofti. Lekki ji likita hokki mo (bana lekki darniiɗi iyam e lekki nyawndooji ɓanndu) darnii iyam, sembe makko lorniti, o waawi faaminde ɓiɗɗo o, ɗum ɓeydi cellal ɓiɗɗo. Ko waɗi ɗoo ko jiiɓru ɓaawo danygol (postpartum haemorrhage) addani ñawu ɓiɗɗo, kono e safaara baawɗo, yumma e ɓiyum ɓe njamndi.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer:
Ɓingel ngel heɓii ko en mbi’ata *birth asphyxia* (ngeeloɗam foofaange e nder danygol), sabu yumma mum heɓaaki semmbe e heɓaaki operasyon e saanga, ɗum waɗi ngel tampinaa, ngel waɗa gaañannde e ɓalli, fofugo ngel ɗaanaani laaɓi.  
Jooni ko ngel haani ko jokkude e hisnaare (incubator) ngam murgo e heɓde oksijen haa fofugo ngel tabita, tawa ɓe ndaara ɓernde ngel e ngeeloɗam.  
So tawii nder balɗe 3–4 ngel fuɗɗi fofugo laaɓi, ngel ñaama e semmbe, ngel walaa seertaango walla jaamba, ngel waawi sellude, kono so ngel loowi, ngel waɗi seertaango malla mette e ɓandu, ɗum holli ngel heɓii rafi ɓernde sabu heeɓere oksijen (*hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy*).  
Ɗo ngel woni hannde ɗon, eɗen mbaawi wasiyoo ɓe neldi ngel to suudu safrirdu mawndu mo jogotoo *neonatal intensive care unit* si tawi ngel ƴellitaaki e nder 48–72 saʼa, ngam ngel yoɓee kuule haɓɓitorde.  
Min ngottoro Alla, amma ɓe mbaɗaace, ɓe ndiwa ngel no feewi so goɗɗum feyyi, sabu ƴiiƴam toontaangal e tampere danygol e yumma suka (duuɓi 13) ina addana ɓiɗɗo caɗeele ɗe keewi.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Ko ngel ɓingel holliraa ko ɗereeji maande kulɓiniide: ngel waawataa yarude ndiyam, fooftere mum ina yaawina, ina semmbi, e nder daande ngel ina nana "ngelde", ngel ɓanndu wuli. Ɗum fuu holli wonde ngel ɗon wonda e rafi caɗtungel bana njabbu yonki (pneumoni) malla buuɓri fooftere, ɗum woni jawdi. 

Ko adii fof, nawtu ɓingel ngal e wakkati gooto to opitaal mawɗo walla safrirde ɓurnde ɓadude ɗo ɓe mbaawan hokkungel ballal fooftere e lekki kolodje (antibiyotik) e jaawle. E laawol, suɓee nokku ɓuuɓɗo, ngel woorde e nonde-yumma, moƴƴinaa, ammaa woto doolee ngel yara ndiyam so ngel jaɓaani. To opitaal ɓe ngaratan ngel montooraago fooftere, heɓa lekki kolodje e hawti e toppitagol bee hakkille, ngam hisnugo ɓingel ngel.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer: Iyam debbo o rufata so daraaki, heewi waɗde ko sabu reedu (utérus) waɗaay sembe caggal danygol (atonie utérine) malla woodi heddiiɗe nder reedu bana bingel goɗɗo (twin) malla heddiiɗe placen. Fuɗɗoraade jooni, mbaɗen poofam reedu bee sembe haa reedu ndu ɗaatiɗo, nden mbaɗen lekki oxytocin 10 IU e nder cuusel (IM) malla misoprostol 800 microgramma nder dudere (rectal) to oxytocin walaa. To iyam daraaki haa jooni, waɗee bimanual compression (juuɗe ɗiɗi nder reedu e dow reedu ngam ɓeyda sembe). Nden neldam debbo o e nder yaawre haa asibiti mawnde, tawreeta e hokkude ndiyam e ƴiiƴam (IV fluids) e laawol. To asibiti mawnde ɓe njogii baawɗe feere bana ballon intra-utérin walla operee, ɓuri hisnugo yonki makko.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: A siforii maa ina nanndi e kokkal keccel (rectal prolapse) baawɗo waɗdeede saabii reeduuji keewɗi e tampinde, ɗo ɓuuɓri ndiyam yaltata tawa walaa uuru bonki. So a leliima, kokkal ngal ana yeeyoo, amma so a darii walla a tampii ana musina. Ngam haɗude ɗum ɓeydaade, haɗ tampinde e nawgol teddeendi, nyaamdu ko heewi puɗi ngam ɗaccitinde. Aɗa haani yaade e safrirde ngam safroowo ƴeewa, sabo operesiyoŋ ina waawi lortude reedu nder keccel. Wota njaɓee safaara aada baawɗo taƴde kokkal ngal, ngam ɗum waɗata ko gelle (fistula) ɓeyda nyawu.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer:
Debbo on e ɓingel mum nana njanguɗo e nguse bonɗe ɗe mbaawata wonde ƴiye ‘impetigo’ walla ‘septisemia’ sabu dorog ledde aadaaji.  
Min ngaddan mo lekki ‘antibiyotik’ e ƴiiƴam (batir) e noon kadi lekki kuɗol ngam ustude nguse ɗee.  
Galleeje, ngaɗen ndiyam laaɓɗam e saabunde welnde ngam lawgol pofɗe ɗee, caggal ɗuum mbaɗɗen ‘Gentian Violet’ (go jego) malla lekki kuɗol woɗngo no doktoor holliri ñaande ɗiɗi.  
Taa ɓe ngara huutoraade lekki aadaaji kadi, ɓe njoɓa lekki ‘antibiyotik’ haa gasa, so ɓingel ngel ɓeydiima wulde malla ŋaaɓnude, ngarten sibiti law.  
Yaa yeen, ɓe ndaranii ɓingel ngel ɗum yara kosam neene, laaɓna ɓalli mum kala balɗe, ɓe ndaara so taƴre nde ɓeydiima yaajnude ko yaawi.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer: Aan, yartu debbo o yaawde to suudu nyawndiigu (hospital). E lebbi jego e balɗe seeɗa, ndiyam e iyam ɗe omo yi’a ina mbaawi hollude fuɗɗoode danygol no haandirta, ammaa iyam sahaa gooto ina waawi ummoraade e rafi placenta bano placenta previa malla abruptio, ɗum en caɗeele baawɗe bonnude yumma e ɓingel. Doktoor en mbaɗan ƴeewndo timmungo, ina heen ultrasound (sk) ngam anndude no placenta woniri e ngonka ɓingel. Caggal ɗum, ɓe njaaboto ko haani – ina woodi sahaaji ɗo operesiyoŋ (caesarean section) yaawɗo hisnata nguurndam. Woto ɗaɓɓu tan sk, sey ɓe ngiɗi mo e juuɗe doktoor ɓe ƴeewa mo e nder suudu nyawndiigu.

Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. model_answer: Wailituggo dande metatatata, wawata mabbutuggo gite, gite mbarta dow, zazzabi, e lola ɗon holla ciwo “Tetanus” (ɓallal dande). Tetanus ummoto ko e ñawu nguu naatata e gaañere nder ɓanndu, haa teeŋti e ɓiɓɓe tokosɓe. Ñawu nguu waɗata ƴiƴe ɓanndu fow mettitaa, haɗa wuddu maɓɓitagol, waɗa gite ɗe mbarta dow, e sahaa gooto addana zazzabi e lola sabu bonnugol laabi ɓernde. So an jaɓaaka safrude law, Tetanus waawi warde, ngam maajum no sattini. Mi wasiyiingo on njaa-ɗon suudu safrirde jooni jooni, to ɓe kokkata mo antitoxin e toppitaare haa teeŋti.

model_answer: Zazzabi, fitaade diuna, waasugo mabbutugo e mettere dande bingel maaɗa ummii ko e nyawu ngoo, wanaa nde wurtinata dande. question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Sukaaɓe ɓe pofɗe e ɗojugol reedu ɓeydotooɗe so ɓe ɗonii ina kollita wonde ɓernde waawaa tamminde ƴiiƴam no feewi, ɗum addana ndiyam yaniyanaade e fooƒere e heeñere, ko ɗum waɗi reedu mum ɗo mumta e fooƒtere nde welaani. So ɓingel ngel ɗonii, ndiyam fooftere ɓuri ɗuɗɗude, ngel fuɗɗota fooƒtaade, ɗojugol ngol ɓeydoo, ɗum waɗi ngel ummotoo kala jamma ngam weltaare. E ko yaawi, nawtu ngel to asibiti mawɗo ɗo ɓe mbaawata ƴeewtaade ɓernde ngel (echocardiogram) e hokkude leɗɗe diuretik ngam ustude ndiyam ɓurtuɗam ɗam, ɗum woni tan safaara goongo. So o wanaa e laawol haa yaha asibiti, waɗu mo ɗo ɗonii e jemma, ɓantiri hoore makko e ko waɗaani e pilaaji tati, o woto ɗoninoo boofel, haa fooftere weeɓa. So o fooɗi semmbe, o woto lelnaa, dartin mo haa ɓe njaaɓa. Majjere wellitgol reedu e pofɗe ɗe ko leɗɗe ɓernde tan (furosemide), tawtoree jaawngol, ngam o woppitoo. Yeru sahaa, ŋakkeende ɓernde sukaaɓe ina adda maayde so safaara leeli.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
reference:
Renoodo bingel lari bingel mai do dojja sosai naudum, har karshe dojjugo mingel nonnon tan foofugo daker.
Toh dume don waddata dojjugo ha bingel banni tan, har karshe dojjugo mai wala foofa boddum daker daker foofata? Goji dime be dime bewawata bewanna bingel mai? Choboraade toi min hokkata mo? Be
Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer: Ɗum gasa ko dartol fooftere (breath-holding spell) saabe mettere suudu saɗti (constipation) heewunde e cukalel. So ɓingel naati woyde fuɗɗiima dartinde fooftere, accu ɗum ko ɗooftii, taa juɓɓe, reen ko waɗata ɗum saɓre. Ngam haɗde suudu saɗti, hokkuɗe ɓingel ndiyam keewɗam, so omo ñaama, ɓeydu ñaamdu leɗɗe ɓowal (fibre) hono ɓowal e puɗi. So suudu no saɗti faa, mbaawen naatna kuɗol suppositoire glycerine ngam wallude suudu yaltude. To dartol fooftere juuti, ɓingel wayli mbaydi (cyanose) walla woppii fooftere lebbi, yahdu to suudu nyawndiigu.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. reference:
Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.

model_answer: Gelo o nanata e sembe walaa makko ummii ko e irtugol iyam heewngol ɓaawo danygol (postpartum hemorrhage), ɗum addani mo anemiya mawɗo. So o walaa iyam boɗɗum sosai, o sokli transfusiyon iyam caɗeele, wonaa tan ñamri, ngam ñamri fuɗɗortaa heɓtaago iyam e nder waktuuji seeɗa. Min ngaddana mo iyam hesere ngam dogginde yonki makko, ɓaawo ɗum ɗon hokka mo supplemaa njamndi (iron) ngam ɓeydaago iyam e nder balɗe. So omo wurtina iyam fahin, en poti haɗugo wurtugol ngol e dow laawol, e mballudi doktoowo.

model_answer: Alamaaji ɗi a yi'i ɗoo wanaa nyawu hakkilo koo mettol ɓernde, ammaa naqisiri suga e bitaminji waɗi ngaandi maako ɗon ɗaani. question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Nyawu ɗo saɗinta ɓingel ma fofugo be ɗojugo nder jamma, ko jontere (malaria) nasti suɗi nder gaba maako. Jamma on kulle jontere man wurtoto haɗa ɓingel fofugo, ɗum waddi lekki Tutolin ɓe hokki mo mai naftirtai. Walaa haaje a tamma nyawu tibi koo asma, ɗume waddata ɗum kanjum on yarugo ndiyam peewɗam be henndu jamma. Ngam a heɓa nyawdinki, hokku ɓingel mai lekki jontere bana chloroquine a jilla be nebbam boɗejam ngam a taasa peewol gaba mai. To a waɗi ɗum, fofugo ɓingel ma wooɗan, ɗojugo mai bo accan wakkati gootel.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Dada gorko ma wolwi gonga, ndiyam danygol on nati kine e hoore ɓingel ma, ɗum on waddi sukko man. Taa fahin a musina mo jotta, ngam kosam ma ɗon ɓesda damba e peewol nder ɓernde mako. Ngam kine mako maɓɓita o foofa booɗɗum, wujju nebbam 'Robb' nder loofa kine mako. Fahin boo, jillu ndiyam gulɗam bee njuumri a yarna mo koondeye fajiri ngam lawjuki damba man. To a waɗi ɗum, ɓingel ma foofan bee hoore mum, o wartan jam walaa haaje likita'en.
