question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tari nyiɗɗum e bone fofaango ɗi ɓingel ma wondi e mum jemma ɗon heewi warugo ngam nyawu goggo (pneumonia) ko bo mbulku (bronchiolitis), ɗum cuurki defirde leɗɗe ɓeydata hallugo. Cuurki man ɗon naawa poofirɗe keccel ngel, ɗum saabi ɗe maɓɓa, ɓingel fofa daaɗe-daaɗe, tuuta ɓaawo tari, bo haɗa ngel musinugo ngam tampiri. Ha asibiti, likita hokkan ngel henndu (oxygen) to haandi, bee lekki (antibiotics) laɓɓina goggo ngel, ammaa taa cooda lekki tari mawniraaɓe hokka ngel. Haa saare, reena ɓingel sosaay daga babal defirde malla nokkuure mari cuurki ngam ngel heɓa ɗaana boɗɗum. Kadima, to ngel ɗon waalo toownu hoore maagel seɗɗa, bo lardu a ɗon wada caasal musingo ngel dakkol-dakkol ngam ngel heɓa semmbe.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: Ngati rawandu wodi hallende masin ngam ɓingel wawan heɓugo nyawu hauka rawandu (rabies) bee tiitaano (tetanus), kadi dammutore wurtotoore ɗon holla kici nyawu (bacteria) naati haa babal ngal. Koda rawandu ndu faalaa naawalla jooni, ndu wawan raɓɓugo ɓingel nyawu hauka rawandu ngel wala safaara to ngel fuɗɗi wurtungo. Dole on nyo'a marɓe ɓingel ɓe yaara mo asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en loota babal ngal, kadi ɓe acca kugal gargajiya man. Haa asibiti, ɓingel heɓan allura nyawu rawandu (anti-rabies vaccine), allura tiitaano, bee lekki mbata dammutore (antibiotics) ngam wara nyawu man. To on ɗaɓɓitaai safaara asibiti lawlaw, nyawu man wawan naatugo ƴiiƴam ɓingel (sepsis) koo addana mo maayde.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Ɗum nyau paɗɗel ko dimbugo ngam zazzabi masin (Febrile convulsion), ɗum heewi heɓugo ɓikkoi pamari to ɓe keɓi zazzabi pabbooje (malaria) ko sela. Irin hakkulungo arannde, ndaarnee ɓingel ngel e waalo (leloo e wute) heɓa ngel foofta boo ngel waawaa moɗugo joode maagel. Taa bittu ɓingel ngel wakkati ngel dimbata, kadi taa loowu bindigol, ndeeli, ko lekki nder hunduko maagel ngam taa ngel hippo. Ɓoortee ngel limce tedduɗe, ɓoggee ɓanndu maagel bee leppi e ndiyam peewɗam seɗɗa ngam zazzabi man jippa. Baawo ɗon, njaaree ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en ndaara asali zazzabi man bano ƴeewndo pabbooje, ngel heɓa lekki kiwtootiro.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Ɗum nyawu faddere (convulsion) gam wulgo ɓandu mangum, bo ɗum waawi latago alama nyawu pabbooje nawɗum (severe malaria) malla nyawu mboowu hoore (meningitis). Taa on naftire lekki gargajiya malla sabulu ɓaleejo gam ɗum wawatā sellungo nyawu ngu, ɗum waawi lornugo nyawɗo baawo tata. On dogga be ɓingel ngel asibiti jotta-jotta heɓa likit'en ndella wulgo ɓandu man, ɓe darna faddere man, bo ɓe hokka ngel ndiyam nder ƴiiƴam. To ngel heɓi magani haa asibiti lawlaw, ɓingel ngel heɓan dama, ngel sellan, bo ngel fuɗɗan nyaamgo nyiiri. Wakkati fuu to ɓingel fuɗɗi wulgo ɓandu, wujje yaago asibiti law bako faddere nden heɓa ngel.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Sannu maada, alaamaji ɗojugo dillataa be saɗteende foofugo wakkati jemma nder ɓingel duuɓi jowi, ɓurna fuu to o walaa nyawu tibi (TB), ɗo holla ɓingel ngel ɗo mari nyawu Asma (Asthma). Asma ɗo waɗa kooɓe foofugo ɓingel ɓita, musamman wakkati jemma malla to jaangol waɗi, ɗum saabi lekki ɗojugo meere bana Tutolin wallataa mo. Feere ma ɗum waawata laatugo alerji (allergy) malla muraatin caatuɗum, amma nder asibitiji meeɗen, Asma on ɓuri waddugo irin nawngeere nde'e to sukaaɓe. Mi ɗo hokka ma shawara yaara ɓingel ngel asibiti pam fahin ngam likita'en mbarita mo, ɓe ndokka mo lekki Asma (bana *inhaler*) ki maɓɓitata garki foofugo maako. To o heɓi magani ki dacee, ɗojugo man dillantin, ɓingel ma waawan waalugo jemma e hoore jam walaa damuwa.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer: Alaamaji ɗi gorko ma ɗon holla, bana eesugo (doyru) duumiindu lebbi ɗiɗi e saɗugo foofugo to o wondi e sollaare, ɗon nufa omo mari nyawu Fuka (Asthma) malla nyawu doyyru gaggawal (TB). Bana likitaajo, miɗo shawra on njaara mo asibiti law ngam ɓe ƴeewa tuute mako (sputum test) ngam heɓa ɓe laaɓina koo wondi e TB ɗum raarata haa lesdi meeɗen. To asibiti tabbintini nyawu Fuka (Asthma) o wondi, ɓe ndokkan mo lekki pampamol (inhaler) ki o foofata ngam foofugo mako hoota daidai. Daga jooni haa on njaha asibiti, doole o reena hoore mako bee sollaare, cuurki, e peewol, kadi o ɓorna maaske (mask) to o ɗon yaha nokkuuje marɗe sollaare. Hokku mo ndiyam gulɗam o yara, kadi on kakkila o jooɗaako haa nokkuuje marɗe kuraaji ngam o heɓa yamɗugo belɗum koo toy o waɗi.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Dadda, rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) e nyawu manngu nguu ɓingel maada wondi e mum (Neonatal Sepsis) ko huunde tiiɗunde masin jo'oni. Miin likita mi hokkete bBatale bano *Oxytocin* ngam darnugo iyam majjum, nden min loota saare ɓingel man (Evacuation) ngam heɓa asar heddi wurto bano a eeli. Ngam ɓingel ngel boo, juuɗe pewɗe e lo'ugo ɓaandu ɗon holla nyawu naatiri iyam haa ngel naati nimsita (shock), ngam maajum min naadan ngel lawlaw heɓa ngel heɓa leɗɗe batte (antibiotics) e nguleeki. Nden boo min ɓeydan ma iyam koo mi winndan ma leɗɗe ɓeydooje iyam ngam a lornita semmbe maada a ayna ɓingel. Yaawugo fuɗɗugo lekki bano nii kanko woni laawol ɓurngol hisnugo yonki dadda e ɓingel nder sibiitiiji meɗen.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel e waawi hisgo tawa oɗon heɓa hendu (oxygen) e magani, amma o naawi ngam juutgo danyngol e ƴellitaare ƴiiƴam daada maako (birth asphyxia). To ngaandi maako wonndaaka masin wakkati o ŋakki foofaango nden, o mawnan o warta ɓingel cellungel walaa aayibe. Caɗeele ɗe fuu iwi ko ngam daada e fadi cukaaku (duuɓi 13) be bo salagol seekeede (CS) nde likita'en mbi'i, ɗum saabi ɓingel tampi nder reedu. Don ngam maajum, on acca ɓingel ngel e daada mum haa asibiti likita'en njokko hakkulango ngel haa foofaango maako fondita. Bee baawɗe Allah e hakkulo asibiti, ɓikkoy heɓayɓe irin caɗeele ɗe ɗon hisa, mawna jam e cellal.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Accu yiwugo ɓingel ngel bee ndiyam pewɗum jooni-jooni, ngam peewol masin (hypothermia) ɗon lora ɓikkoi pettoi, ɗum waddata ɓingel fofa da dadei e ɓandu maagel lo'a. Sawru ɓingel ngel nder limse ngulɗe malla ɓaɗɗin ngel haa ɓandu maada ngam ngel heɓa nguleeki lawlaw. Yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti walaa fesa, ngam fofugo da dadei e lo'ugo ɓandu lambaaji nyawu mangu on bana nyawu ɓokko-ɓokko (pneumonia), ngel haandi ngel heɓa lekki e henndu (oxygen). Kuruuji malla layaaji ɗi ɓe pilli haa ɓandu ɓingel walaa ko wallata haa hala ɗo, diyam pewɗum e nyawu saabi ɗum, ngam maajum asibiti tan woni daldal kisndam maagel.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer: Nyawu ngu debbo ɗo waɗata ɓawo danygol innde maagu *Postpartum Hemorrhage* (PPH), ɗum waddata ɗum ko heewi bana saalugo reedu (uterine atony), heddoore koo taygo nder ndaaya, koo boo goonga ɓingel goɗngel heddi nder reedu maako. Ko haandi on waɗa jooni-jooni kanjum on moosa reedu maako ngam ndu taƴa, bo on fiya mo batal *Oxytocin* koo on hokka mo lekki *Misoprostol* ngam darna iyam man. Ngam o walaa sembe jooni, on mbasa rokkugo mo ndiyam ɗaɗi (IV fluids) law-law ngam sembe maako fita kadi reena mo taa iyam maako maasa. To on waɗi ɗum fuu iyam daraki koo on tawi ɓingel didaɓel ɗon nder, on tura mo asibiti manga law-law ngam o heɓa ɓesdaari iyam bee wakkati mooftaago ngurndam maako. Ɗum woni tsari min naftirta nder asibitiiji karkara Afirik ngam hisnugo yonki innaaru to iyam rufi ɓurtini ɓawo danygol.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: A goongɗi, ko haɗata ɓingel ma musinugo boɗɗum ko kine maagel ɗe sukki ngam ndaamba (pewol), naa ndiyam naati hoore wakkati danygol bana no daada gorko ma wi'i. Ɓikkon keccol foofat ko bee kine, ngam maajum to kine sukki, ɗum saɗtan ɓe musinugo ngam ɓe heɓataa foofaago wakkati ɓe njarnata ndiyam enɗam. Ngam wallugo ngel, rottu ndiyam kine je likita'en (saline drops) seɗɗa nder kine maagel ngam laaɓina ɗe, bako a fuɗɗa musinugo ngel. Tabbatin a ɓorni ngel boɗɗum ngam ngel heɓa nguleeki, nden ɓamtu hoore maagel dow seɗɗa to aɗa musina ngel ngam ɗum walla ngel foofaago. Ammaa to a ndaari pofɗe maagel ɗon yaawa masin, ngel ɗon waɗa ɓandu wuli (fever), koo ngel sali musinugo pat, waddangel asibiti lawlaw.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer: Taa windin lekki ɗojjoore acca ɓe kuuca saare; dolle ɓingel ngel foti jaɓeego (admitted) haa sibiti jooni-jooni ngam pofɗe ta'ooje ɗe ɗon holla nyaw pewuri masiin (severe pneumonia). Bana no anndal nyawndagal meɗen holli, ɓingel marngel lebbi jeego ko heɓi ɗojjoore balɗe sappo e nayi e fofugo sama-sama ɗon nder tiiɗe, nden ngel haajiri ndiyam pofɗe (oxygen) e piirol baturje (antibiotics). Hokkugo ɓikkoy lekki damba malla lekki ɗojjoore kanti ɗon halla nyaw man, nden boo ɗum waawan ta'ugo pofɗe maɓɓe. Jaɓu ɓingel man haa nder waadi (ward) law-law ngam a laara ndiyam pofɗe maagel e ngam a fuɗɗa hokkugo ngel lekki ki jeyaa. Luttugo maɓɓe haa sibiti on hokkata en damagal laarugo ngel koodeye haa pofɗe ngel yeeɗita booɗɗum.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer:
Sannu maɓɓe, alamaaji ɗi on mbii bano naawol reedu be ɓawo, hawtaade be ndiyam be iyam ɗon wurta, ɗon holla masiba reedu wari ngam lebbi jeego yottaaki wakkati danyaago (preterm labor). 

Wurtaago ndiyam be iyam ɗon nufa ndiyam ɓingel fasake lawlaw koo bo maande ɓingel (placenta) ɗon maɓɓita, ɗum bo woni nyawu cattuɗum nder kuugal amin ngal asibiti. 

Ee, on haandi on waɗa hoto reedu wato "scan", ammaa koo bano nii on haandi on ndogga be debbo man asibiti mawnundi jotta-jotta ngam likitaajo ndaara mo. 

To on leeli, reedu man waawan fukkaago koo bo debbo man waɗa asara iyam ɗuɗɗam, ɗum faddata yonki maako be nge ɓingel man. 

Ndoggee be maako asibiti lawlaw ngam o heɓa ballal e tayaago ndiyam be iyam man bano no haandiri.

model_answer: Sannu maada, alaamaji ɗi a yecci bana zazzabi mangi, yoorgo daande, e waasugo maɓɓugo yitere ɗon holla ɓingel ngel ɗon mari nyawu "Meningitis" (nyawu mboomaari koo shammoore nder ngaandi). Yoorgo daande e waasugo maɓɓugo yitere ɗon waɗa ngam kuroori nyawu nguu ɗon naawa ɗaɗi e ɓokkoondi ngaandi ɓingel maada. Ndi'i nyawu naawraari mawndi masin, ngam maajum yaaru ɓingel man asibiti jooni-jooni, taa faɓɓu sam koo a ɗaɓɓa lekki leɗɗe. Ha asibiti, likita'en mbeendata ɓaandu maako ngam ɓe annda tigi ko waɗi zazzabi man, nden ɓe pija mo botiire (injections) marɗe semmbe ngam kasugo nyawu man. Taa leelu sam, yaaru mo asibiti law ngam hisnugo yonki maako e haɗugo naawallaaji lutta haa ɓaandu maako.

Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer: Sannu Tilola, alamaaji zazzabi, diwugo, e daande tiiɗnde ɗi ɓinngel maada ɗon holla ɗon fira nyawu masiin kulniingu bi'eteengu "Meningitis" (sannjo) ngu memata ɓaawo ngaandi. Daliila yitere wootere waawataa maɓɓugo woni nyawu ngun ɗon saapa ɗaɗi yeeso ɓinngel ngel (facial nerve palsy) ngam kibe mbadi masiin nder ɓandu maɓɓata ɗaɗi man. Haa asibiti on likita'en mbaɗata gwaji man, ɓe ƴeewa ko woni nder ɓandu maggel, nden ɓe yeccha ma asali nyawu ngun. Doggu yaaru ɓinngel ngel asibiti jooni-jooni walaa fasaago ngam ngel heɓa lekki tuppugo (antibiotics) lawlaw, sabo nyawu ngun e waawi mbargo koo lalla ngaandi maggel haa abada to ngel heɓaay magani law.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Alaamaji ɗi ɓingel ma holli, bana ɗojere ɓillande nder jamma be iidugo ɓerde wakkati pofɗe, ɗo holla nyaw fuka (asthma) koo bo pewol mangol muɓɓi poofirɗe mako. 

Ɗum ɗo waɗa ngam poofirɗe ɓingel man ɗo usta koo ɓuuta, ɓurna fu nder jamma to pewol waɗi, kanjum waɗata pofɗe saɗata nden ɓerde ɗo iida. 

Ngam ustugo be haɗugo ɗojere man ummago, handi dada man hakkila acca ɓingel man faandita kujeji bana cuuɗi leggal (nduha), sollaare, dabbaaji, bee pewol. 

To nyaw man ummi nder jamma, valli ɓingel man jooɗa darna ɓawo ngam o waawa foofugo boɗɗum, nden a ɓorna mo kare guluuji ngam pewol. 

Ha asibiti, likita'en hokkan mo magani fampugo (inhaler) koo ndiyam ngam maɓɓitugo poofirɗe mako, ngam maajum tokku umroore asibiti bee hakkilo ngam hisnugo yonki mako.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.

model_answer: Alamaaji ɗi daada lari, bana ɗojju naawngu haa ɓingel waawaa foofugo bo ɗon fiifa henndu, ɗon holla nyawu ɗojju ɓoyma (Pertussis/Whooping cough) koo shahi (pneumonia), ngam kootuuji (bacteria) ɗon laha ɓokkooji henndu ɓingel. Handi daada yaara ɓingel asibiti yaawdum ngam likita'en ndaara mo, ɓe keɓa hokkugo mo henndu (oxygen) bee lekki warooji kootu (antibiotics) ngam hisnugo yonki mako. Bana shawara haa daada, taa o wada lekki leɗɗe koo dume haa saare, kadi o reena ɓingel daga pellel curki yiite koo kura ngam taa ɗojju man ɓesda. Dow koo ɓaawo ɗon, handi o tabbita ɓingel heɓi bakkal (immunization/vaccine) laamu timmundum ngam faddugo nyawuuji irin ɗi'i yeeso.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. model_answer: Alaamaaji ɗi on ngi'ata ɗo ɗon holla debbo man ɗon rufa ƴiiƴam masin ɓaawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ɗum ɗon waɗa to reedu maako rammitaay koo boo o heɓi seekel wakkati o ɗon danya. question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Alamuuji ɗi mbinndi-ɗon ɗon — bee jooɗugo feere, luttugo haaju fijirde, e salaade nyaamdu — ɗon nandi sanne bee nyau ɓillaare ɓernde mawnde (depression) ko dammuɗum hakkilo. 

Ngam mballon mo, handi kuuton bee makko bee munyal, mbolon mo bee jooɗugo e makko, taa kujeenon mo kadi ngaddanon mo nyaamdu ɗum o yiɗi. 

Alamuuji kallaɗi ɗi mballata andugo o ɗon haaje likita law-law woni: to o ɗon haala dow accugo yonki makko, to o sala nyaamdu pat, ko to o nani bolle ɗe goɗɗo nanaay. 

Handi njaddon mo haa asibiti ngam o lara likita mo andi nyauuji hakkilo (psychiatrist) o heɓa maggal e shawariiji poottuɗi. 

Taa njaɓon o lutta feere makko, ngam wallitteego diga saare e sooba'en ɗon wallita sanne haa o warta bana no o woni nane.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tari jemma, fofungo e bone, e waɗugo lawo to keccel lebbirɗe tati woni alaamaaji caɗeele ɓalndu bana sotta-sotta (*bronchiolitis*) malla jofe (*pneumonia*). Ɗo ɓeydoo jemma ngam henndu peewri, bo salaade musingo e fofungo yaawgo woni maalle caɗeele mawɗe (*danger signs*) ɗe a fotai naftirgo lekki saare ngam maaje. Sey a yara mo asibiti mboɗɗum ngam likitoci nkesɗina mako mbalura fofungo (*oxygen*) malla lekki njaaje ngo mbonnata mako ɓalndu. To o ɗon fofa e bone, a wawan jooɗnaago e makko dadiiɗo (uuruɗo) ha gaandu ma ngam o heɓa helowgo fofungo banni bo a ɗon hokko mo ɓiraaɗam endu seɗɗa-seɗɗa. Hakkil e reenugo mo diga cuurki kuoral, peewri, e mbuure ngam o heɓa jam e ɗaano boɗɗum jemma.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Ɗon haaje jaawunde ɓe yara bingel ɗo asibiti jontajonta ngam heɓugo safande yaawunde ngam hisgo yonki mako. 

Ha asibiti, likitoci ɓasoto babal ngatande ɗon, ɓe ngana mo lekki kayeefi (*antibiotics*) ngam laɓɓingo dammutore e burtungo huynunde nde lekki gargajiya waddi. 

Bingel ɗo mari haaje heɓugo riga-kafi ciwo kaandi rawandu (*Rabies vaccine*) jontajonta, koo da rawandu ndun ɗon dama, ngam reitugo ciwo rawandu mbaroowo. 

Ɓe nangan mo kadi riga-kafi tamasari (*Tetanus vaccine*) ngam ta’eeki lekki gargajiya man be dudal dammutore ngun. 

Accee safande gargajiya ha ngatande rawandu jonta, ngam ciwo rawandu (*Rabies*) walaa lekki to o fuddi wadugo kuuje goɗɗe ha ɓandu.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɓingel maaɗa heɓi ko wi'etee *dimbugo ngam zazzabi* (febrile seizure), ko ɓuri saabeego bee zazzabi mbuuɓu (malaria) ha lardin meɗen. 

To ɗum waɗi, fudo mbilinaa ɓingel ngel ha wuttuldu (recovery position) dow leydi koo mbeela ngam ta o ɓuuta, kadi ta a waɗi koɗume fuu ha nder hunduko maako. 

Jippina zazzabi man bee pottol ngol a sulki ha ndiyam ɓulɗam (lukewarm water) a ɓuuɓna ɓandul maako, ammaa ta a fati mo ndiyam peewɗam masin. 

Ndillaa bee maako asibiti lawlaw ngam likit'en ndaara ko addi zazzabi man (bano malaria koo mbuuɓu ɓandu) ngam o heɓa safara potɗo. 

Ta a huutiri laabi mbonɗi bano loofuki ngaska koo naftirgo leɗɗe bee kine koo hunduko maako, ngam ɗum ɗon lannata yonki ɓiɗɗo.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Nyau nangiɗo ɓingel maada ɗum ko wi'etee giide (convulsions/seizures), bo ɗon heɓo saabi wulaandu ɓandu masin bana zazzaago (malaria) ko mborre kunu (meningitis). Yaaree ɓingel man asibiti jotta-jotta gam o heɓa batte (injections) bee lekkiiji dartintoojum giide ɗon bo safra ko waddi wulaandu ndon. Haba bee ta mbaddee lekkiiji gargajiya, sabulu gari, ko loope ha hunduko makko, gam ɗum ɗon maɓɓa laawol foofugo makko bo ɗon nawnan mo masin. Ko nanngee waɗugo jotta ko waalinki ɓingel ngel ha sengo gooto (recovery position) gam ɗiyam ɗon wurtoo ha hunduko makko bo o heɓa foofugo laaɓngum. Nyau ɗon maran dama masin to on yaari mo asibiti law gam heɓugo kure gonga.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer:
Ɗojjuru lebbi ɗiɗi e saɗeende fofugo jemma e ɓinngel duuɓi jowi ɗon holla alaamaaji astma (asthma) koo kadi nyau tibi (TB) mo heɓay lekki muɗum deydey. Astma ɗon addana datuuji henndu ɓinngel hiɗɗugo jemma, ɗum woni ko addanta mo fofugo saɗungo e ɗojjugo haa o uja. Lekki bana "Tutolin" wallataa ngam nyauji ɗi, kadi huutorgon maajum mardo haari ɗon lanna heɓugo maggal deydeyɗum. 

Ɗon haani njaa-ɗaa e makko haa asibiti ngam likita’en mbadana mo koonye bana "Chest X-ray" bee kadi binndigo ɗojjuru ngam tewtugo ngonka makko. To ɗum astma on, o heɓan lekki fofugo (inhaler) ngam udditgo datuuji henndu makko, boo to tibi on kadi o heɓan maggal potungal ngal o sellira.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer:
Alaamaaji ɗi ngolluɗaa ha gorko maa—bana foofugo caɗtungol, ɗojjo duumiingo lebbi ɗiɗi, ɓiraawo saande, e yiisugo soolaji bee jaangol—ɗon holla caɗeele mawɗe bana ngilngu kaaba (Tuberculosis/TB) malla caɗeele ɓernde. 

Ngam maajum, ɗon haani njahen mo jooni-jooni ha sibiti (hospital) ngam o waɗe jarribaari talol (sputum test) e hotto gaba (chest X-ray) heɓa hefta ko nawni mo. 

Ta nattiree lekki majjaaki so doktoor winndanaay mo, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓesda caɗeele ɗon. 

To o heftaama bee ngilngu kaaba (TB), lekki mum ɗon heɓoo meere ha sibitiji laamu ammaa o yoɓataa ko mbuɗu, e ɗon sellina timmi. 

Hannde jooni, carree mo ha pellel henndu laɓɗum ɗon yaha, kuwtinee mo bee kolte ɗelɓe, njahee sibiti ngam o heɓa jam e jooɗande belɗum.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Rufugo ƴiiƴam ɓaawo dayugo e nyawu mborodi (sepsis) ngam luttuɗe bofi walla ƴiiƴam boɓɓungo haa nder riga ɓiɗɗo on waddi ɓandu dada man wula, koɗse mako bo fewa, bo o rufu ƴiiƴam bee robe. Likita ɗon yiɗi laɓɓina (lota) nder riga ɓiɗɗo (uterus) mako ngam ittugo luttuɗe ɗen bo ɗum fadda rufugo ƴiiƴam e nyawu ngun. Min mbinndanay mo leɗɗe darnugo ƴiiƴam (batal ko kwaye), leɗɗe kuɓtinooje mborodi (antibiotics) e uurngo ndiyam (IV fluids) ngam darnugo ƴiiƴam man e yaɓugo zazzaure nden. Ngam o laɓi bo o somi sanne, o yiɗi heɓugo ƴiiƴam gurnol (blood transfusion) ngam sembe mako lorta, o wawa hakkilugo e ɓiɗɗo mako. Ɗum ɗon woni sabaabu gaddoojo mbariku (emergency), ngam man heɓugo nyawndagol parpar haa asibiti ɗon mari nafa sanne ngam hisnugo yonki dada man.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Ɓingel man ɗon njiimi caɗeele ɓillugo e luural fofugo (*birth asphyxia*) ngam danyugo ngo booyaay ko tetti sanne. Dimbugol ɓandu (*seizures*) e sellaay fofugo man ɗon holla wonde dital hoore ɓingel ngel heɓaay oksijin ko heyi wakkati danyugo. Hokkaago oksijin joni e kuurgal asbitila mari nafari sanne gam hisngo yonki ɓingel ngel e daggugo caɗeele hoore. To Allah walli o hisi, o waawan wongo e jam, amma ɗon mari damuwa dow heɓugo caɗeele dital hoore yeeso bana *cerebral palsy* ngam danyugo ngo tetti man. Likitocen ɗon huuwa ko handi, ngam man tokke umrooje maɓɓe fuu jooni ngam ɓingel ngel heɓa faabo.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Fofugo jaawngo e caɗeele fofugo haa ɓiɗɗo petel woni maale nyaw mawnunde wano pneumonia malla sople, nden ɗum na heɓa ngam peewri. 

Accee yiwugo ɓiɗɗo bee diyam peewɗam, ngam ɗum ɗon ɓeyda peewri ɓandu (hypothermia) kadi ɗum ɗon yaasi caɗeele fofugo maako. 

Yaaree ɓiɗɗo o asibiti jooni-jooni ngam likita'en ndaara mo, mballa mo bee fofugo (oxygen) kadi ɓe ngena mo lekkiiji goonga. 

Ko njaahoton asibiti, kuurtee ɓiɗɗo oo bee kolte ɓulɗe ngam o heɓa ngulaandi ɓandu. 

Ta kuutoree lekkiiji ledɗe malla lekkiiji boɗeeji ɗi likita jootaayi ngam ta ɗum ɓeyda caɗeele ɓiɗɗo man.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɗum waawan laatago saabe maru danyugo (uterus) sunkitaaki (not contracting), ko boo saabe woodugo ɓingel goɗɗo luttuɗo nder reedu, ko luttuɗum ɓaltoore danyugo (placenta).

Ko addu kuugal, taba reedu debbo man ngam tabbitingo wala ɓingel ɗiɗabo luttuɗo, nden nyanndee (massage) reedu ndun sembe ngam wallitgo maru man sunkitoo darnugo iyam.

Hokkee mo batal *Oxytocin* (10 IU) ha dango (IM), ko boo kwaye *Misoprostol* (kwaye 4, 800mcg) ha les ɗemngal ko ha dango (rectal) ngam darnugo iyam man.

Konne mo iyam ɓaleele (IV fluids) bana *Normal Saline* ko *Ringer's Lactate* bee fetooji mawɗi (cannula) ngam sembiɗingo ɓandu maako ko taƴa sembe.

So tawreeta iyam ɗon sali darugo ɓawo wadugo kujeji ɗon, neldon mo asibiti mawɗo (referral) lawlaw ngam hisgo yonki maako.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: A woodi gonga ko a yardataako e haala "ndiyam naati hoore" man, ngam caɗeele foofugo e musungo e ɓingel duuɓi ɗiɗi naa ngam ndiyam on. Ɓikkon keccun e kine tan pofata wakkati musungo; to kine majjum sukki, e waawaa foofugo e musingo wakkati gootol, ɗum on waɗata o acca musingo. Ɗo ɗon nanda bee nyaw mbuuku (neonatal infection/sepsis) bee pewol ngol haandi likita’en ndaara ngam hisnugo yonki ɓingel man. Mi ɗon afora ma njaha suudu lekki (asibiti) jooni-jooni ngam likita’en kuuwa kine mako kadi ɓe korta mo lekki ngol natti nyaw man. Taa tiɗɗina mo o musa bee doole ngam o taa tuuta kosam man nden ɗum naata e kine mako naa ɓernde mako.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. model_answer: Ɓinngel maaɗon ɗon mari nyaw pofɗe keeso (severe pneumonia) e caɗeele pofde mawɗe, nden ɗum haajiri en nastina mo sibiti jotta ngam yaawre larde mo. Jotta haa sibiti ɗo, en puɗɗan hokkaango mo henndu pofde (oxygen) e lekki kurngilaaji (antibiotics) je mbelata mo bee yaawre. question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.

model_answer:
Sannu, ɗum ɗon holla wonde debbo o ɗon mari matsala mawɗo ngam lebbi jego bee balɗe seɗɗa naa wakkati jibinol yotti ya, ɗum ɗon yiɗi yahdu asibiti ɗon-ɗon. 

Ndiyam bee iyam ɗon wurta bee nawoore reedu ɗon holla alama luttugo reedu bako wakkati (preterm labor) malla matsala bee heɓre ɓiɗɗo (placenta). 

Eyyi, nafi ɗon heɓugo scan (ultrasound) ɗon-ɗon ngam likita’en lara no ɓiɗɗo man bee ndiyam mum ngoniri nder reedu. 

Min ɗon ma’ina on kootton asibiti mawɗo ngam heɓugo wallitoore bee law, ta kuutan kuuje saare walla fukkiigo ha saare. 

Tokkugo asibiti law waawan hisgo yonki debbo man bee ɓiɗɗo nder reedu mako.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.

Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? model_answer: Ɗojuru be caɗeele pofɗe jamma bano nii ɗon heɓa ɓiɓɓe ngam koondi ɓuuti (croup) walla astma ɗon faddana jolgo henndu. Ngam wallugo ɓingel ngel jooni, darnu mo o jooɗo nden o fufa henndu bee lirre gulɗum (steam) ngam maɓɓitgo mbeɗu pofɗe makko. Hakkilanee ngam yi'ugo kuyeji nyawu bano tonduuji buluki (cyanosis), suttol dabo-dabo dow ɓernde (chest in-drawing), walla to ɓingel ngel waawaa yarugo kosam walla dyam. To on ngi'i gooto nder alaamaaji ɗon, njaadde asibiti jooni-jooni jamma ɗo, ta ndonnee haa fajjiri. Ngam ittugo ko ɗon adda ɗojuru ndu, ndee'e ɓingel ngel bee cuurki cuurngo, colla, walla pewol jamma.

Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? Wawan lata mettol berde on na koh torrugo hakkilo on damata mo? Her toi min wawata vallugo mo gam seyo mako warta? Beh alamaji toi handi en hakkila? Handi o lara hokko shawara na koh likita mo andi nyawuji berde?
model_answer:
Ɗee alamaji—joɗude e suudu, accude yewtude, ŋakkude yidi e ko o yiɗunoo, walla waylude nyaamde/ɗaanude—ina waawi wonde **depression (sikkitaare mawnde)** walla nyawuure hakkille goɗɗe, wonaa ko “ɗowre” tan.  
Yewtee e makko no newi, hokkitee mo hoolaare, woto on nyallu mo walla on waɗu mo jamfa.  
Ɗowee mo asibiti ngam likita walla likita nyawuji hakkille yo ƴeewto mo; ina waawi soklude shawara, magani, walla ƴeewtagol ko kwayoyi/drugs, malaria, typhoid walla stress.  
So o wi’i o wara hoore makko, o nana ɗemɗe/yi’i ko woodaani, o haɗi nyaamde, walla o wonti bonɗo/aggressive, ɗowee mo **gaggawol** asibiti, woto on acc mo gooto.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.

Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji ɗe njogi bone: tari mawɗo jemma, yaltinde keccel caggal tari, fuuɗugo no waɗi sawru/huɓɓugo walla no yaawi—e ɓingel suka ɗum no waawi wonde **bronchiolitis/pneumonia, wheezing/asma, walla pertussis**.  
Yo on njah ha **asibiti/likita hande** ngam aƴƴa fuuɗugo, oxygen, ngulɗam, kadi o heɓa lekki mo haani; hoto on hokku syrup tari, antibiotics, walla lekki gese ɗo suudu tawa likita yi’aali.  
Ɗo suudu: ɓorni ɗannde, hokku keccel/ndiyam seɗɗa-seɗɗa, jogii mo ɓuurii dow caggal yarugo, fowti hanci e normal saline, tee haɗa tabaaki/ƙura/ƙamshi.  
To o salii yarugo, o jogii ngulɗam, fuuɗugo ɓuri yaawde, ƙirji no naata, leɓɓi no ɓalee, o ɗiɗi ko o tampii—**yahee emergency jooni**.

Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko haala ɗaɓɓitiiɗo: so rawandu waɗii ɓingel ngam ɗum, rawandu oo fuuɗii yuurugo/ɗutugo walla maayi, ɓingel oo hani ko yahugo asibiti jooni-jooni.  
Lekki gargajiya e fere bandu ɗin ɗon ngalaa ndeeje ngam haɗa rabies; rabies so waɗii, ko bone mawɗo, tee so alamaji mum fuɗɗii, ɓuri heen no haɓɓude.  
Ɓe loot bandu ngatinnde nde ndiyam e sabulu ko miniti 15, ɓe ƴettu mo asibiti ngam allurar rabies (anti-rabies vaccine) e rabies immunoglobulin so ngatinnde nde ko mawnde, kadi allurar tetanus e antibiotics so dokita yi’i.  
Hoto ɓe wara lekki gooɗɗo e bandu nde, hoto ɓe sakkita, sabu allurar rabies maaɗa nde waɗi hade alamaji fuɗɗude.  
So rawandu oo ina wuuri, ɓe ndaar mo nyalɗe 10; amma so maayi walla fuuɗii nyawde, ngam safety ɓingel oo hani ɗumɗum heɓa magani rabies ɗoo e ɗoo.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena waawi wonde **zazzabi ɓurɗo** (sanko malaria walla infection) waɗi ɓingel **jinjol/dimbugo**; ko ɗum ɓuri waɗde e ɓiɓɓe sukaaɓe, kono ena waawi wonde ko ɗum mawɗum.  
So ɓingel dimbii, **woppu mo e ɗaɓɓere makko (side)**, ittu ko mo waawi hawrude, **hoto naatnu huunde e hunduko**, hoto okku ndiyam walla leppi tawa o alaa hakkille.  
Yahdu e mo **asibiti/PHC jooni**, ngam a ƴeewta malaria, meningitis walla infection goɗɗo, e o heɓa lekki zazzabi e magani moƴƴo.  
So dimbugol ɓurii **miniti 5**, walla ɗum ruttii, walla ɓingel yamirtaako/alaa hakkille, ɗum ko **gawat (emergency)**.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko ɗalil nyawu virus, ena wa’i no **chickenpox (varicella)** walla **hand‑foot‑mouth disease**, sabu ɓulɓuli/kujeji ndiyam e ɓandu e hunduko, nguleeki, e nyaamde ɗo metti.  
Amma so ɓinngel waawataa yara ndiyam walla nyaama, walla nguleeki ɓurtii, walla ɓulɓuli ɗi nana huɗi/ɓorni, **nawee mo asibiti jooni** ngam dokter yiyde mo.  
Hoto kuutoro sabulu walla leɗɗe gargajiya e ɓandu oo; ɗum ina waawi ɓeyda ɓornude/infection.  
Hokku mo ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, kunu/ORS, nyaamri ɗi newi, e **paracetamol** ngam nguleeki/mettere; hoto hokku aspirin.  
Ndeen nyawu ena yaha e yimɓe, waɗ mo ka yeeso seeɗa, hoto o hawru e ɓiɓɓe woɗɓe haa ɓulɓuli ɗi ɗo yooɗa.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer:
Alaa, ɓingel nde o woni e fofugo saɗaare e jemma walla ɗojugo ko ɓura lebbi ɗiɗi, waɗ ɗum e asibiti/likita jooni—ƴeewto TB, asthma, pneumonia walla allergy, ndeen waɗa chest X‑ray, GeneXpert/sputum test, e ɗowtannde oxygen.  
So tawii oɗo heewi “wheezing”, no waawi ɗum woni asthma; lekki mum ko salbutamol inhaler/nebulizer, kono ɗum fotaani so ɓuri ɗum likita waɗani.  
Hoto njogito Tutolin/cough syrup tan, sabu ɗum waawaa wuurde ɗawol ndeen, e ɓingel ɗum waawi waɗde sleepy walla ɓeydude fofugo.  
Ƴetto mo ndiyam, waɗ mo honey seeɗa so o ɓuri hitaande 1, haɗu mo e ɗiiɗi/ƙura/hayaki, amma si o ɗo fofugo no saɗi, leɓɓi mum ɗo laaɓi/siiɗi, walla o ɗo dilla dow—yaa emergency jooni.  
So TB test laatike positive, leɗɗe TB ɗe asibiti njogii ko waɗata, hoto acca ko huutora lekki gida-gida.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko fii waɗi ɗum lebbi ɗiɗi: hofugo ɗe yahaani, hoosugo/ista akai-akai, naange ɓernde walla solaji—ɗum ina haani o yaha asibiti jooni, ngam aawndee TB, pneumonia, asthma/bronchitis walla ɗalle ɓernde.  
To o waɗi hofugo sattunde, ɓernde ina naawa, ɓandu ina wulwula, o waawaa haala walla leɓɓi makko/ɓandu ina wayla bulu, ɗon ko emergency.  
Dokita maa waɗu X-ray naange, gwajin solaji (sputum/GeneXpert TB), gwajin oxygen, e gwaje-gwaje goɗɗe, ndeen lekki fotata.  
Hoto walla shafa lekki pellel ɓernde tan waawaa waɗde ɗum bonde; hoto naftoro antibiotics, steroids walla “inhaler” so dokita hokkii ɗum woodaani.  
Haa nde njah-ɗon asibiti, o joɗo/ɗaɗɗo dow, o haɗa sigari/ƙura, o yaran ndiyam, paracetamol tan so naange/ɓernde naawi.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗari: ɓingel lebbi tati ɗo rufa sembe, ɓandu wuli, juɗe e kosɗe ɓeyi, ɗo somi sosai—ina waawi wonde infection, malaria, ko ŋakkere ndiyam.  
No feewi mo waddi mo sibiti; o waɗanee jarrabooje, ndiyam drip/ORS, e lekki ɗum likita hokki.  
Botal/feeding bottle so ɗum laɓɓinaaka no feewi, ina waawi naataade kwayoyin cuta ɗum waɗa rufugo e gudawa; nono inna tan ko ɓuri moƴƴude haa lebbi jeegom.  
So rufugo ɗo waɗa ko ɗuuɗi, o waawataa muynude, o tampii, o soɓataa, walla ɓandu wuli, yo mo yeeytinee likita ɗoon e ɗoon.  
Lekki likita hokki nde tawii ɗum ko ɗum o ndaarani, ina waawi wallude; hoto hokku lekki goɗɗo ko maganin gargajiya ɗoon ɗoon.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer:
Ko a siftii ɗum ina wayi no **ɓingel ngal jibinaa ɗoo laawol ɗimbi/anus woodaani** (*imperforate anus*), ɗum ko nyawu jibinannde, wonaa sabu dango walla ko debbo waɗi.  
Ɗum ko **haaju gāwɗo**: waɗee ɓingel ngal **jooni-jooni** to asibiti mawɗo ɗo **likitan opreshan ɓiɓɓe** woni, sabu ɗimbi ina waawi renndude e reedu.  
Haa likita yiyata, **hoto hokku mo nyamdu ko ndiyam**, ɓe waɗa mo drip, tube, antibiotic, X-ray/ultrasound, ɓe ndaara kadi ɓernde, kodaaji e daande.  
Jokkondiral mum ko opreshan: ɓe maa uddita laawol ɗimbi, walla ɓe waɗa **colostomy** (laawol ɗimbi e reedu) ɗum ɓe tiiɗina ɓawo.  
So ɓe waɗi ɗum e jaawol, ɓingel ngal **ina waawi hisde e mawnude no ɓiɓɓe goɗɗe**, amma ina sokli rewindo likita sabu ɗimbi jogoraade walla constipation.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗaare: ɓinngel petel so o waawataa muynude, o fofata yaawde/tororde, o wiiya, walla o ɗaccitay, ina waawi wonde pneumonia walla infection ƴaawngal.  
Nduttinee ɓinngel ɗo asibiti/PHC jooni, wota on ɗoɓɓu haa dango, sabu ɓiɓɓe petel maaɓe ina bonna law.  
Haa nde on yahi, hokkee mo nono ɗooɗɗum so o waawi, ɗowtinee mo no feewi, tee reentee mo hitaande.  
Wota on hokku mo magani suudu, ganye, ko diyam pewdum no feewi ngal waɗaaki.  
So o ɗon wiiya, o tampi fofugo, walla o yiwataa, yahree emergency jooni.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Ɗum ko **gorgol jiiɓngol e debbo reedu** (antepartum haemorrhage) — sababuuji ɓurɗi heewde ko **placenta previa**, **placenta abruption**, miscarriage, walla rupture uterus; ɗum ina waawi waɗude shock e bonnude ɓinngel.  
**Hoto waɗ vaginal examination** walla naatnude junngo haa placenta previa laɓɓinaaka, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude jiiɓngol.  
Ko mbaaw-ɗon jooni: leɗɗinee mo e sera nano, waɗee **IV cannula ɗiɗi**, hokkee **normal saline/Ringer lactate**, ɗeentinee BP/pulse, aawdee jiiɓngol ngam **grouping/cross-match**, hokkee oxygen so woodi.  
Alaa lekki gooto ɗo “darna” ɗum e asibiti tokoosi; soklaa ko **jiiɓngol/blood transfusion** walla tiyata cesarean so haaju woodi.  
**Turaa mo asibiti manga jooni-jooti** e IV fluid ɗon doga, ngam ɗum ko emergency.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer:
Ɗum ɗo a siftii ina nanndi e **ɓoggol nono/keccal ko udditii walla mastitis** (nono ɗo ina waɗa musungo sabu ndiyam nono jooɗii), walla **ɓinngel ina nawa nono no feewi**.  
Ɗo jooni waɗ **kompres ndiyam ɗungel**, ɗowtu ɓinngel no moƴƴi ngam hunduko mako naatu e nono feewi, walla **ɓenndu ndiyam nono** so o waawaa muɗɗude.  
A waawi huutora **paracetamol** ngam musungo, kono hoto ñaam antibiotics si dokita hokkaa.  
So nono ɗo waɗii **boɗɗum/ɓulɓuli, fufude/pus, hara, yiite, walla musungo ɓurti nder sa’a 24–48**, yah asibiti/PHC jooni ngam ndeen ko mastitis/abscess ɗum sokli leɗɗe.  
Hoto waɗu sembe e nono; so honduko ɓinngel boni latch, nurse/likita rewɓe ina waawi hollude no o waɗirta.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati.
