model_answer:
Ɓingel lebbi 9 ɗo heɓi ɗojere balɗe 13–14, o waawataa yarugo/ɓoftugo walla ɓanndu makko pofɗi, ɗum ko **alamuuji haɗari**; hoto ndeen mo e suudu, wadda mo sibiti jooni.  
E sibiti ɓe ƴeewta **dehydration**, malaria/sepsis, sukari, electrolytes, e nyaamdu bonɗum/kwashiorkor; ɗum ena waawi waɗde o lolli e o waawataa fofa.  
To o waawi yara, hokkee **ORS ndogo-ndogo e koppi/spoon**, jokkinee muynude, e **zinc 20 mg balɗe 10–14**; hoto hokku **damba/lekki gargajiya** walla bottle.  
To o jogii dehydration mawndi walla shock, o foti **admit** ngam ndiyam IV/NG no feewi; amma to pofɗe ɓanndu/kwashiorkor woodi, drip fotaama hakkunde ngam ina waawi bonnude—ɓe huutora ReSoMal/F-75 e antibiotics ɗum e protocol.  
Antibiotic hokkaama tan to jiiɗi infection/dysentery/cholera walla severe malnutrition, kono ko ɓuri waɗugo ko wadda mo sibiti ɗoon ɗoon.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. model_answer:
Debbo ndee ko ɓuri waɗde nawa hoore-hore to suudu hakilo/likita jooni, sabu so ndiyam ɓillii walla o woni e naange, bingel e debbo ɓe poti waɗde haɗari.  
To ndiyam ɓillii ko ɗum ina waawi addude njangu, mettuɗe, walla bingel heɓa caɗeele; likita yo ƴeewto ɓernde bingel, ɗaɗi, ɗumma, e no debbo yahrata, ngam suɓa ngam faddude walla CS so waɗi haaje.  
Hoto ɓe naatnu hay huunde nder laawol debbo, hoto ɓe waɗu magani gargajiya, hoto ɓe waɗu ƴeewndagol vaginal ɗuuɗɗum.  
So o waɗi jiiɓol ƴiiƴam, ndiyam ɗi naange/fuuɗi, yonde, huraare, heɓɓere hoore mawnde, fuɗɗoore, walla bingel waasi dimbude—ɗum ko alama haɗari.  
Ngam ɗum, ɓe yartu mo sappo-sappo to asibiti/PHC ɗo midwife walla doctor woni; ɗum ɓuri moƴƴude e hisnude debbo e bingel.

Zazzabi e dande ɓinngel no metti/walaa waawi yiltude ko alama bonɗum, ina waawi wonde **ciwon sankarau (meningitis)** walla infection teddungal.  
On yahdu mo **asibiti/emergency jooni**, sabu o sokli ndaarugol dokita e magani law.  
Haa nde on yahata, on waawi hokde **paracetamol** e dose fotde e kilo mako, on hokkir mo ndiyam, kono hoto on hokku aspirin walla maganin gargajiya, hoto on ɗappi dande mako.  
So o waɗi jiri, o ɗaɓɓi, o waawataa hebugol, o woni muyɗum, walla gite mako no hulɓini haske, ɗum ko gawatugol ɓuri—yahdu mo asibiti ɗoon-ɗoon.

question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
reference:

Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer:
Bingel maa so ɓandu mum wuli (zazzabi) e dande mum waɗi ndikki/walaa waawi yiiltude, ɗum ko **alama haɗari**—ina waawi wonde *meningitis*, malaria mai tsanani, walla wata infection.  
Ɗaworo mo **asibiti/jawleeru mawnde jooni-jooni**, sabu ɗum ina waawi waɗde haɗari e hoore/ɓerne so lawol ɗawgol heɓaaki.  
Hade nde njaha, a waawi hokke **paracetamol** ngam zazzabi (so aɗa anndi dose mum) e ɓorni mo no feewi, kono hoto waɗu mo maganin gargajiya walla antibiotics ɗo wuro.  
So oɗo yiɗi waasude, oɗo heɓa seizure, oɗo ɗoyɗi, walla o waawataa yarude, ɗum ko gaggawa haa ɓuri.  
E asibiti be ndaarata malaria, meningitis, e infection, be hokke magani daɗɗiiji no antibiotics/antimalarial so ina waɗi.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Dada, ɗojere nde ɓingel ɗo habda fufugo walla ɓerde mako ɗo fiyata, ɗum ko ko waawi wonde asma/ƙirjin ɗum ɗarii, pneumonia, walla infection nder puccu—waɗi ɗum waɗi o foti yahugo asibiti ko gila jooni, ko wanaa jango.  
So tawii o ɗo fufa jaɓɓere-jaɓɓere, hunduko/ɓeɓɓe mako ɗo waɗa bulu, o wala wawa yarugo walla o ɗo nayeeji, ɗum ko haɗari—yahaa emergency.  
Haa nde on yetto asibiti, waɗee mo o jooɗa ɗo ɓernde mako ɓamta, okkee mo ndiyam seeɗa-seeɗa, teel njaram ɗam ɗoɗɗum, ngam ɗum ina walla ɗojere; woto on hokku magani “cough syrup”, antibiotics, walla tawol/pofɗe ɗe doktor waani, ngam ɗe ina mbaawi bonnude.  
So ɓingel ko mawɗo e duuɓi 1, hunuko mako no fadda, on mbaawi huutora “saline drops” e suudu hunduko, amma woto on huutora steaming/dum burtol ngam ina waawi ɓurnude mo.  
Dokita maa nana ɓerde, waɗa oxygen nebulizer/magani fufugo walla antibiotics so pneumonia woni, ngam ɗum ko ɗiɗo ɗi woodi ngam ɗojere e fufugo ɗo leydi men.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
reference:

Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena nanndi e **roowo (gudale/diarrhoea) ɓinngel**, so wala ƴiiƴam e stool, wala fufaaji, ɓinngel ena ɗotta/ɓeyda njaram, aɗa waawi fuɗɗaade **ORS** ɗo wuro.  
Hokku mo **ORS seeɗa-seeɗa laawol kala nde o roori**, tee jokkondir ɗottugo ɓiraadu/nyaamdu; so ORS alaa, waɗu **lita 1 ndiyam laaɓɗam + cokali sukari 6 + cokali gishiri ½**.  
Hokku mo **zinc**: so o jaɓɓii 6 lewru, **10 mg ñalawma 10–14**; so o ɓurii 6 lewru, **20 mg ñalawma 10–14**.  
Hoto hokku mo magani dari roowo walla antibiotic so dokita waɗaani, sabu ɗum waawi bonnude.  
Yahdu mo asibiti ko jooni so o waawataa yara/ɗotta, fufaaji ɗuuɗi, ƴiiƴam e roowo, nguleendi, ɗoyngal/sunki eyes, ndiyam kusel seeɗa, walla o tampii/ɗaɓɓitii.

model_answer:
Ɗum ko **alama haɗari ɓawo jibinannde**: waawi wonde o bonni **ƴiiƴam**, BP makko ɓuri toowde/eclampsia, walla kilungo ƴiiƴam—ngam sembe walaa, gite no yi’a laaɓɗo, ɗaanugo/jomɗugol.

Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tari jemma, fofugol bonngol, e sala musugo ɗum holli keccel laru tati mari rafi ɓawo (bronchiolitis walla pneumonia), ngam laabi fofugo maɓɓe ɗon famɗi. Ko ɓuri himmugo ko yaarugo mo safrirde law ngam o heɓa oksijin e lekki, ngam rafi ɓawo e keccel tokosel wawa warta bone mawɗe law. Ha galle, dada man foti yargugo mo non seeɗa-seeɗa koo saa'i ngam o heɓa semmbe, o haaɗa hokkugo mo leɗɗe galle (defadira) ngam ɗum wawa bonna mo. O laaɓina hunuko makko e ndiyam lamɗam (saline drops) ngam udditugo laabi fofugo, o watta mo e cuurki. Jooɗinugo keccel man seeɗa (upright position) wakkati ɗaanugo wawata wallitugo mo fofugo boɗɗum e ustugo tari jemma.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: To bingel holliti maandeeji nyawu rawandu (rabies) bana ni, walaa safara walla lekki ki wawata safarde mo sabu nyawu ngu safataake to maandeeji puɗɗiima. Ko dokitaaɓe mbaɗata jonta ha asibiti ko hokkugo mo leɗɗe ɗe mballata mo heɓugo jam (palliative care), ngam o maaya bana neɗɗo, amma walaa ko wawata hisinde mo. Lekki gargajiya walaa nafoore ha nyawu rawandu; ngam hisinde bingel to o ngataama, hani a yaara asibiti jaaɓi-jaɓi ngam o heɓa allurar *Rabies vaccine* ko adii nde maandeeji puɗɗoto. Jonta, en ndokkan mo leɗɗe *sedatives* ngam ɓeydugo mo jam haa sa'aaji makko kakkilani, ngam nyawu ngu wurtataake.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Nyaw ngal debbo darnajo on heɓi ko zazzabi mbonndi (severe malaria) ndi yottii kwakwalwa, sabu dimbugo e majjugo hakkilo ko maandeeji tiiɗal zazzabi. Ɗum holli wonde parasite zazzabi naatii e ƴiiƴam kwakwalwa makko, waɗi o fuɗɗi wada jinkilaaku e waylagol hakkilo. E laawol nyawndigo men, ina haani a ɗowta mo law to asibitii ngam o heɓa allurar *Intravenous Artesunate* ngam hisnugo nguurndam makko. Zazzabi yaltataa e nonnon, amma ɓingel ngel ina haani reeneede haa inna mum cella sabu o waawaa ɗon ɗamina mo. Njaawnee ɗum law ngam zazzabi kwakwalwa ina waawi warde neɗɗo so nyawndigo ɓooytii.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Ɗum ɗon holla nyau pes (chickenpox) ko nyau ɓikkon goɗɗo, mo wawan warta caɗeele sanne sabu ɓelol hunduko ɗon haɗa ɓingel yargo ndiyam (dehydration) kuma mbarodi ɗon wawa naata ha ɓanndu rewrude ha gabaki faddi ɗin. A haandaa hokkugo ngel leɗɗe gargajiya ko sabulu gargajiya, sabu ɗum ɗon ɓeyda nyau ngun, wawan warta mbarodi ha ƴiiƴam (sepsis), ko wawan halkugo ɓanndu. Nawtu ngel haa asibiti yalla annduɓe ɓe ndokka ngel safara paracetamol ngam ɓustugo nguleeki kuma ɓe mballa ngel yara ndiyam ko ORS ngam haɗugo ɓanndu raɓɓinaago. Suulito ɓanndu maggel bee ndiyam laaɓɗam tan, taa fawu kujeji ha gabaki ɗin ngam haɗugo mbarodi naatugo. To a jaggiri safaraaji asibiti, ɓingel ngel wawan sella law taa heɓi batal bana nyau ƙwaƙwalwa ko pneumonia.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Mi yamiran ma a acca hokkugo ɓingel ngel lekki ujugo (cough syrup) ngam anndinoore laawol (WHO) wi'i lekki ujugo bonnan ɓikkon les duuɓi ɗiɗi, mi ɗaɓɓitan ngel hospital ngam anndugo ko addani damuwa fofugo man. To ngel woodi nyau fofugo (pneumonia) wala ɓuuɓri, mi hokkan ngel oksijin (oxygen), antibiotik, wala lekki udditirgo fofugo (salbutamol) ngam wallitugo ngel fofugo. Wawan (vomiting) ɓingel ngel ko sabu ujugo saɗini ngel fofugo, to mi safri fofugo man, wawan man ma ittu boɗɗum. Ɓam ɓingel ngel a yaha hospital ɗon e ɗon yalla mi ɗaɓɓita ngel mi hokka ngel safara laaɓuɗo, ngam damuwa fofugo e ɓikkon koyan ko haani yaawgo safre.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer: Gorko maa ɗon mari haaje yahu asibitu jonta ngam o heɓa foto ɓanndu (X-ray) e jarriborgal babellaji ngam heftugo to pellel mako ko TB (fere fere) ko asthma. Islugol lebbi ɗiɗi, babellaji, e solaji ɓanndu to o isla ɗon hollita o waawi marugo TB, saali min njara lekki haa min hefti ko waɗata ɗum. Lekki mo o haani naftirgo ngam hofugo mako ko "inhaler" to ko asthma, amma to ko TB, asibitu hokkan mo lekki TB ɓaawo jarriborgal ngam laaɓugo hofugo mako. Haa wakkati jarriborgal ngal yaltata, o haani ɓoorna "mask" ngam o raaya ma, kuma suudu maɓɓe haani wurtina henndu no feewi. Taa sooda lekki isla ha kasuwa tan, ɓeyda yahu asibitu ngam dokitirajo fahma ko waddani pellel mako sabou lebbi ɗiɗi ɓiti.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ɗon wondi e rafi ƴiiƴam tiiɗɗo (neonatal sepsis) bee cuurki (jaundice), ɗum waɗi o haani heɓugo lekki maɓɓitinki (antibiyotik) nder ƴiiƴam kiiɗum. Yaye maako ɗon wondi e rafi rufugo ƴiiƴam sembe ɓawo dayugo (secondary PPH) sabu rafi suudu mawna, ɗum waɗi o haani heɓugo lekki darnugo ƴiiƴam (uterotonics) bee lekki maɓɓitinki. Neldugo maɓɓe to likitaajo sukaaɓe (pediatrician) bee likitaajo rewɓe (obstetrician) ko laawol ɓurngol moɓɓugo ngam hisnugo nguurndam maɓɓe. Nder asibitooji men, ɓingel ngel juuɗe mum e koyɗe mum fewi ɗon holla rafi ƴiiƴam (shock), amma yaye maako rufata ƴiiƴam sembe ɓawo balɗe tati ɗon holla haaju ballitoowal kiiɗum. So ɓe keɓii safaara kiiɗum, sembe yaye maako wurtan, o waaway hokkugo ɓingel maako nono ngam o heɓa cellal.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Miɗo faama hal maa, amma to bingel ngel hisi, cellal mako e yeeso ina fawii e no hakke oksijin yottinoo nder kwakwalwa mako wakkati danyugo ngoo juuti sabu ŋakkere fofaango (birth asphyxia). Hokkugo ngel oksijin e nder suudu nyawndiigu ina wallita ngel fofa, amma dokitooɓe ina poti ƴeewndaade no kwakwalwa mako gollortoo nder balɗe seeɗa garooje ɗee ngam anndude to ngel heɓii caɗeele kwakwalwa (brain damage) walla rafi dilla (cerebral palsy). To ngel fuɗɗiima nyamde e fofde no haanirta nder balɗe tati, ngel waawi wartaade bingel cellungel, amma to ŋakkere ndee heewnoo, ngel waawi heddaade e caɗeele hakkille walla ɓanndu. Ko ɓuri himmude jooni ko woppugo ngel nder junngo dokitooɓe opitaal ngam ɓe ndewinda ngel haa anndee to ngel wartan bingel cellungel na alaa.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Nda ɓingel ngel ɗon ɓilla taa hunnduko maggel ɗon yaltina pummbuure, lelnu ngel e bannge nano (recovery position) ngam haɗa ngel muɗɗaako, taa watta huunde e nder hunnduko maggel. Dokku ngel safara *Diazepam* e nder reedu (rectal) ngam darta ɓillagol ngol law, ɗum ɗon hisna ɓerni maggel e haɗa foofaango ngoo bona. Ɓillagol ngol e gaspugol (foofaango bone) ɗon holla rafi malariya ɓerni (cerebral malaria) walla meningitis, ɗum waɗi a foti yottugo ngel e asibiti law. Taa ƴama ɓingel ngel no tiiɗi, kaa laɓɓin hendu maggel ndokkaa ngel oksijin so a heɓii ngam hisna nguurndam maggel.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer: Rufugo iyam sembe daratado ɗon wadda sabu redu debbo on darnataa (uterine atony), ɗum wawi lataade sabu ɓiɗɗo fere nder redu, leppol heddii, wala redu on maawnii sosai. Hokku mo lekki *Oxytocin* (wala *Misoprostol*) kisan, ɓillu redu makko be junngo ɗiɗi, nden tura mo asibiti manga kisan. Hakkande ɗum, jokku hokkugo mo iyam (IV fluids) ngam wallitugo sembe makko, nden ƴeewa hara ɓiɗɗo fere ɗon nder redu makko. Sabu asibiti amin walaa kakkilanɗe ngam darnugo rufugo iyam mawngo to ɗon haaji opareta wala ƴiiƴam, neldugo mo asibiti manga ɗon haani sosai ngam hisnugo rayuwa makko.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Ɓingel mako ngel ɗo mari ɓannu (catarrh) e kine ɗe cuukii, ɗum waɗi ngel waawaa musinde sanne sabo ɓingel ɗon pofa bee kine, to kine ɗe cuukii ngel heɓataa pofɗe to ngel ɗo musina. Waɗa ndiyam saline nder kine magel yeeso musungo ngam wallitago magel pofa e musinde boɗɗum. Reento waɗugo safaraaji gawri dow hore magel sabu ɗum ɗon adda rafiiji ɓurɗi bonnugo ɓanndu magel. Musinir ngel seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɓuwa law, ngam haa ngel heɓa doole e ndiyam ɓanndu. To ngel ɗo mari pofɗe ɓurɗe yaawugo, mbileewu (fever), wala ɓanndu magel ɗon ɓilla to ngel ɗo pofa, jawtu ngel opital ngam likita en ndaara to ngel walaa ɓannu mawɗo (pneumonia).

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer: Ɓingel man ɗon mari rafi pofɗe halli (severe pneumonia) be ndiyam ɓanngu (severe dehydration) sabu leɗɗe bilaaɗe be waccugo nonnon, ɗum waɗi min kokka mo lekki nder ɗaɗol (IV fluids) be oxygen jonta. Sabu o ɗon musa ko fuu, hokkugo mo batir nder hunduko walaa nafakka, amma min tilsi min kokka mo IV be lekki antibiotik ngam haɓɓugo rafi pofɗe. Min yamiri debbo man waccugo leɗɗe "damba", "dargo", be "sorata" ɗen fuu sabu ɗe ɗon mbara ƴiiƴe ɓingel, min puɗɗita hokkugo mo nonnon Formula ɓaawo o heɓi semmbe. Min ɗon ndaara kadi sukkar nder ƴiiƴam (blood sugar) mako sabu waccugo nyaamdu ɗon kawta hawtal sukkar les (hypoglycemia), ɗum woni laawol WHO ngam dandugo ngurndal ɓiɓɓe marɓe rafi pofɗe halli.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. reference:

Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer: Ɗum ko sahaa tiiɗo no feewi, sabu maandeeji ɗii (yiiƴam, ndiyam, e muuyal) holli wonde omo jogii jibineede ko adii sahaa e ndiyam ɓesngu yaltii ko adii (PPROM). Eɗon haani nawde mo safrirde mawnde ɗo woni doktooruuji rewɓe law, hay so tawii laawol ina saɗi, sabu nguurndam makko ena fawii e ɗuum. Waɗde taƴgol reedu (C-section) e lebbi 6 ina saɗi sabu bingel ngel ooftaaki, ammaa so yiiƴam ɗam ɓeydiima walla nguurndam debbo oo ena fawii e caɗeele, doktoor ena waawi waɗde ɗum ngam hisnude mo. Haa ɓe njottii safrirde, lelne mo, o wota o yaru ndiyam walla o nyaamu ngam haɓaade taƴgol reedu so ina haani. Ko doktoor tan waawi ƴeewde mo e nder safrirde mawnde ngam suɓaade laawol ɓurngol hisnude debbo oo e bingel ngel.

Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.

model_answer: Maandeeji ɗi mbiy-ɗaa ɗii, wano zazzabi, tiiɗal daande, e caɗeele gite, ko maandeeji kulbiniiɗi ɗi ñawu *meningite* (ñawu ƴiiƴam hoore) ngu woni ko yaawi no feewi. Min ndokkan mo safaaraaji *antibiotiques* ɗi njippintee e nder ƴiiƴam ngam halkude bakteri addi zazzabi e tiiɗal daande ngal, wata a waɗa mo safaaraaji galeeji sabu munyal waawi addande mo bonnugol hakkillo wala maayde. question: Inde amtilola daga keya bandu bingel am do wuli odo fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man wetata waituggo yite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dumejum on wawata wuda zazzabi do be ko bo hadata dande mako waituggo gol handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako waituggo jawabu toy bo be yecchata men je ko woni dar bandu bingel man je waddata zazzabi be ko wadata dande mako wodi go
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer: Yaaru bingel maa asibiti kisan kisan, ngam dande mako tiiɗi, gite mako ɗon yiiloo, hunuko mako waawaa udditaade, ɗum woni maande nyaw meningitis wala tetanos. Nyaw tetanos wala meningitis ɗon maaya bingel so a leeli yaarugo mo, nden dokitooɓe asibiti ɗon mbada mo allurai safara e nder ƴiiƴam. So tawii ko zazzabi, ɓe mbadan mo safara zazzabi, amma tiiɗal dande e yiilol gite ɗon holla wonde nyaw man ɓuri zazzabi. Hoto a jokka, yaaru asibiti jooni-jooni ngam hisnude nguurndam bingel maa, hoto a huutoro safaraaji galle.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Ɗojere be tawol pofɗe jamma fu ɗon holla wonde ɓingel man ena waawi heɓugo nyaw pofɗe (pneumonia) ko fufugo tiiɗungo, nden a haani yaawugo yahuago asibiti jooni-jooni. Haa a yaha asibiti, ɗaanin ɓingel man dow sumto, yarngo mo ndiyam ɗuuɗɗam, nyaamino mo honi (to o ɓuri duuɓi go'o) ngam usta ɗojere, timtina kadi suudu haa hendu laaɓndu wooda. Hakkila be maandeji kulbiniiɗi bana pofɗe ɗon yaawa fufugo, kaccal ɓerde ɗon lugga wakkati fufugo, ɓingel man waawaa yarugo, ko ɓanndu mako ɗon wayla laata. Haɗu hendu cuuli, boofal, ko kuuje ɓuuɓɗe nder suudu ngam ɗum ɓeydata tawol pofɗe be ɗojere. Likita asibiti ena taska ɓingel man hokka mo safaraaji haanuɗi caggal nde o andi nyaw man, amma waddaago mo yahuago asibiti wakkati fuf ko haani.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
reference:

Toh dume don waddata dojjugo ha bingel banni tan, har karshe dojjugo mai wala foofa boddum daker daker foofata? Goji dime be dime bewawata bewanna bingel mai? Choboraade toi min hokkata mo? Be

model_answer: To kosam yumma yonataa ɓingel har karshe nonnugo, a fuɗɗa hokkugo mo nyaamdu ɓeydudi bana *akamu* mo ɓeydaa man gyada walla kosam, ngam o heɓa semmbe. Yumma ɓingel nga haani yara ndiyam duuɗɗam, sha *kunu*, nden nyaama nyaamdu moƴƴuru ngam ɓeydugo kosam makko. Walaa safara keeriiɗo mo a hokkata ɓingel ngam karshe nonnugo, amma to o woni e wullugo, a ɓatta mo, a memma mo haa o heewa nyaamdu. A yahda e ɓingel nga asibiti ngam o heɓa allurar rigakafi e Vitamin A, nden a reena laaɓal nyaamdu makko ngam hisnugo mo e zawo.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. Pellel sam o yiɗi ɓinngel debbo to min waddini min waɗini ko haandi fuu en waɗata ɓaawo redu jobay ni min hoosi daada bee ɓinngel maako min yari bee hasudu ɓe siwta ndee seɗɗa sey dada man nyoniya o yecci amin o ɗo nana o walaa. O nana osomi gite mako o yi'ata laɓɗo o vi' amin ogodi nyamugo ɓawo o danyi amma da kek o heɓi o nyami be nyiri mai wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta oɗo ɗaana o wala sembe be o fuddi nanugo gelo on feɗi bannin ko iyam vurti ha mako sosai o wala iyam o handini ko o handi ni. reference:
Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.

Min hokkamo eyam na?

model_answer: Debbo on ƴiiƴam mako wurtake sosai (Postpartum Hemorrhage) sabu redu mako jippaaki, ɗum wadi o maayi sembe, gite mako ɗon nyaama, o nana gelo (hypovolemic shock). Min hokkata mo "Normal Saline" (iyam 0.9%) walla "Ringer's Lactate" bee ɓoggol mawngol (IV line) ɗiɗi ngam wurtugo ruwan nder ɓanndu mako yaawgo. Sabu ƴiiƴam mako wurtake sosai, tilay min hokka mo ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) ɓaawo min heɓi "cross-match" ngam hisna nguurndam mako. Ha wakkati man fuu, min pookan redu man (Manual Removal of Placenta) bee hokkugo mo "Oxytocin" ngam reedu mako tiiɗa, ƴiiƴam mako darta. Ɗum woni laawol ngol "WHO" e "Federal Ministry of Health" Nigeria hokki ngam hisna debbo danyuɗo mo ƴiiƴam mako wurti.

question: Mi hakkili ko am pertiido mo vowi fijigo be sobirabe mako sanji wakkati gotel jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum o acci yewtogo bo o wala fala ko vowi yidugo mi hakkili bo ko min je woni sare o yida nyamugo be amin odo nandi mo woni der bella ko chamri kala wakkati fu kadi dume on wawata latata sabulu dasugo bandu mako be sobirabe mako wawan lata metol berde on. kotorugo hakkilo on damata mo hertoi min wawata valliugo mo gam siyo mako warta be alamaji toi handi en hakkila handi o lara hokko o shawarana ko likita mo andi nyawuji berde.
reference: Mi hakkili miko am pertido mo vowi fijugo beh sobirabe mako canji wakkati gotel. Jotta hanko tan jodata ha sudu mako kullum. O acci yewtugo, bo owala fala ko o vowi yidugo. Mi hakkili boh ko minin jeh woni sare, oyida yamugo beh amin . Odo nandi mo woni der billa koh chomri kala wakkati fu. Kadi, dume on wawata lata sababu dasugo bandu mako beh sobirabe mako? model_answer: Waylo-waylo jikku makko e metol hollata ko ñaw berde walla hakkille tiiɗɗo, wa waylo no firo berde, ñaw HIV, walla mbonngo hakkille. Sabu waylo-waylo jikku e metol, ina haani ƴeewndaade so tawii ko ñaw ɓanndu addi ɗum ko adii fof. Aɗa foti nawde mo to opitaal mawɗo ngam yiytude likita berde (Neurologist) e likita hakkille (Psychiatrist). Ɓe mbaɗan ɗum ƴeewndo ɓanndu e ƴeewndo berde (CT scan) ngam anndude sabu mum goonga. Wota on tuugoo tan e safaara aada, ɗaɓɓee safara likita ngam cellinde ɓanndu makko e deeƴinde berɗe mon.

question: Dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari laru je tati bei nange ɓingel mai pijal boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tari tari mai ɗo ummina keccel man daga ɗo yiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jamma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fufa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi danugo ngam o hutiri defadira waɗi dada mai hakkilri ɓingel mai sali musun. fijugo no o vowi sai o yari keccel mai ha likita ngam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sitta tari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toi e wannata bingel man lamɗol am ko watata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo hada bingel man fufugo boɗɗum wawan wada tari be bonede fofugo man alamutu ɗume bei ɗume wawata wadugo ha sare heɓa keccal man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma.
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Ɓingel man no mari ñawu fofugo e hucco (common cold), ɗum waɗi o no fofa be ndiyam hucco bo tari man no ɓeydoo jemma sabu o ɗo vudda. A wawata hokkugo mo paracetamol ngam ustugo tari man, bo a hutora ndiyam lamɗam (saline drops) ngam laɓɓingo hucco man. Hokku mo ndiyam ɗuuɗɗum bo a reena mo ngam o votta fufugo no feewi. Sabu en ɗo lesdi malaria, so tari man yaltaaki ɓaawo balɗe tati, a foti arda mo likita ngam o waɗa test malaria. Ñawu fofugo man no heewi yaltugo e hoore mun nder balɗe jeegom, amma so o fuɗɗii wakkilugo henndu no yaawugo, arde mo law.

question: Rawandu ngati bingel bandan dubi mako je didi rawandu mai gati mo be yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta’i babal mai sai wati lekki fere inde majum abboro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo dammutore bo ɗuti en yacci ɓe yara mo asibiti pusani iri kala ri ɓe wannata bingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo ngam rawandu mai ko da rawandu mai ɗo dama bo iri safande toi hani a wanna bingel petel ɗo mawandu mai wannai mo il fere ha bandu mako.
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer: Rawandu ɓanndu bingel dubi je didi ngal no waawi wonugo "Scabies" (kullon ɓanndu) walla "Impetigo" (rawandu bacteria), sabu lekki gargajiya ngal no waawi ɓeydugo walla bonnugo ɓanndu. A haani dakkugo lekki gargajiya ngan, a laaɓina ɓanndu bingel ngel ndiyam laaɓɗam, nden a wartugo mo asibiti ngam dokkitooɓe ɓe ndaara ɓanndu mun ɓe annda ko woni rawandu ndun. So tawii ko "Scabies", ɓe ndokkan ma "Permethrin cream", so tawii ko bacteria, ɓe ndokkan ma "Antibiotic ointment" hani e lekki nyamdu. Hoto a waɗan bingel dubi je didi lekki a anndaa, sabu no waawi bonnugo ɓanndu mun walla addugo rawandu mawndu.

question: Debbo darnajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako de o lari zazzabi nangi gal mai non non tan fuɗɗi dimbugo bingal mai do wada jinl wala der hakkilo irin nyautoi hebi bingel dadalgu sumdo be irin hakkulungo hakkilinta bingal do.
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Ɗum ɗon holla wonde ɓingel ngel no mari sukara lesɗuɗo (hypoglycemia) walla zazzabi tiiɗɗo naati hakkillo (cerebral malaria), sabu dimbugo, yinaro, e ɗaɓɓugol hakkilo tawa wala nguleeki. A foti nawrude ɓingel ngel to hospital law law ngam ɓe ƴeewa sukara makko e ɓe ndokka ɗum safara. Der gese amen, en ƴeewata sukara ɓingel ngel fow, en ndokkata ɗum sukara der ɗaɗol (IV dextrose) so o lesɗii, en ndokka ɗum kadi safara zazzabi tiiɗɗo. Hoto a waɗa ɓingel ngel safara ma a walla safaara leɗɗe, ngam ɗum no waawi ɓeydude bone e hakkillo makko. Hisnude ɓingel ngel no ɗaɓɓi safara hospital law ngam haɗude bone hakkillo e maayde.

question: Dada mu suno bingel mako kuma o do larani bandu bingel do wula wakkati bo da lori vi o yidda saali o yi bandu bingal mai gabaki daya tid sai o faddi bo o anda ko daya bol mako do mabbi. Gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo vurtina mo ha hunduko kuma ɓingal mai wawata maɗa kala nyiri fu jotta oɗo ema elkita ko irin ɗo o maran nyauɗo maran dama kuma be irin nyau ganɗi ko o wawan o heɓa batal. Koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon ɓe naftirinta ɓingel be iri nyauɗo ha vurti.
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina jogii rafi "testicular torsion" (fiiltagol ƴiiƴam ɓanndu ɓaleeri) walla "hernia", ɗum ko rafi potɗo safrude e safrirde (hospital) kisa. Alaa sabulu gargajiya walla safaara aada mo mawna safrude ɗum, naftiraade ɗum ɓeydat tan ko bonnude ɓanndu nduu haa maaya. Larani e ɗiyam ɗi wuli ɗam o waɗani ɓingel ngel ɓeydii rafi ngel, sabu ɗum ina haɗa ƴiiƴam dogde no haanirta, ɗum waɗi ngel ina woya sabu niyere. Ƴettu ɓingel ngel yaha safrirde ɓe ƴeewa ɗum e nder waktu juutɗo ngam hisnude ɓanndu nduu e nder safrude ɗum e ɓernde (surgery). Woppu sabulu aada, laawol gootol ngol woni ko yaha safrirde mawnde ngam hisnude nguurndam ɓingel ngel.

question: Likita mi waddi ɓingel dubi jui be lebbi ɗiɗi kuma oɗo lebbi ɗiɗi ko sali oɗo be damuwa be fofugo saɗini mo jamma kuma o ɗo uja. ɗo ni sali dillugo mi sodini mo lekki ojjugo tibi inde magal tutolin chuld o yardi gora gotel amma ɗojugo mai dillai kuma har jotta ɗo be jemma ɗo saɗini mo mi wanni mo je tibi. Amma be vi wawan o wala nyau tibi ɗum likita ɗume on waddata ɓingel duɓi jui heɓa ittugo wala acca ɗum be kuma ɗume on waddata ɓingel dubi jui heba damuwa fofugo daker ɗo be tamma.
reference:
Likita miwaddi by bingel dubu jew be lebbi didi , kuma odo be banin ko lebbi didi ko saali , odo be damuwa be foofugo do sadinimo jamma, kuma odo ojja kullum kullum. Hojjugo dooni salli dillugo. Mi soodi nimo lekki dojjugo TB, inde maagal Tutolin Children . O yardi goora gootel amma dojjugo mai dillai.kuma har jotta do dojjugo be jamma do sadinimo.
Mi wanni mo goji je TB, amma bevi wawan owala yeewu TB do.
Likita, dume don waddata bingel dubi jew heba hojjugo wala accha do, be kuma dume on waddata bingel dubi jew heba damuwa foofugo daker do be jamma?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina waawi heɓde tibi henndu (asthma) walla caɗeele ɓernde, sabu saɗtinde fofugo e jamma ko maande laaɓtunde ngam ɗum. Lekki ojjugo tibi o nafi ɗum sabu laabi henndu nder ɗon ɓilla, te ɗum ɗaɓɓi ko leki fofirgo (inhalers) wano salbutamol ngam yaajnude laabi henndu ɗin. Aɗa foti artirde ɓingel ngel to opitaal ngam ɓe ƴeewta so ko asthma, ɓe ƴeewa kadi so o wala ɓuuɓri (anemia) walla tibi ɓernde. Kadi, reendu ɓingel ngel e suura, puyru, e huunde fof waawnde addude ɓuuɓri e nder suudu ngam wallude ɗum fofugo no moƴƴi.

question: Inde ame ɓawo lebbi ɗiɗi ko saali ɗo militina gorko amofugo mako da dedai ba sam be odo ista akai akai banda ma odo babellaji ko habe saunde odo isla akai akai ni bofugo daidai o hokka. Ɗo waɗa ta’a be oɗo isla to oɗo solaji wodi ko je min waɗata heɓa hefta ko waɗata ɗotugo ɗo be isugo ko julde ha pellel mari solaji ko ɓandu mako ɗon. Chanta waɗata ɗum fe’a irin lekki toi ɗon o naftirta hofugo mako hota dedai be kuma o wawan o joɗa belɗum ko ha o woni fu.
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer: Alaa lekki walla safaara e nder ganndal cellal ndi waawi mawninde ɓandu gorko. Weltaare guurugal ɓandu ɗon fawii e yewtugo, faamugo, e waɗugo ko adii ɗum, wanaa mawnuki ɓandu tan. Ɓellaji e waasugo ɗanngo ɗo o mari ɗum ko maande tawaare e hakkille sabu weltaare, kuma o haani yaha asibiti ngam ƴeewteede so tawii alaa ñawuuji goɗɗi. O e gorko mun haani yewtugo no feewi, be ɗaɓɓa ballal annduɓe cellal hakkille ngam heɓugo faamugo e weltaare. Hoto o naftiro leɗɗe ɗe anndaaka ɗe o wiyetee ɗe mawninta ɓandu, sabu ɗe waawi bonnugo cellal mun haa laaɓa.

question: Mayi ɓingel mako mo ɗo wondi be mako tun o dayi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi rufata ɓawo dayugo bo rufa be robe sembe nda dedai ma o yiini fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe koste yeso. Tou ɗo tauna ɓandu ɗo wuli amma ha dar ɓalle tati ɗo ko sari ɗo kosɗe mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo o ɗo somi somini sosai bo wala ko o wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo sibiti heɓa. Likita lara ɓandu mako o yami ko wawan likita mai lotai babel mingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo otori likita mai vindina mo batal ko lekki je darnata iyam mai heɓa dada mai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkina ɓingel.
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Ñawu ngun ko ŋakkeende Vitamin K (Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding) nde sababi rufugo iyam ɓingel, sombugol, e ɓuuɓgol juɗe e koste sabu ŋakkeende sembe. Lekki Vitamin K ɗo likita o waɗi ngam darnugo rufugo iyam, e ndiyam e sembe ngam wurtinugo ɓingel heɓa sembe mako ko laawol cellal ngol likitaaɓe kuwatorta. Maande ɓuuɓgol juɗe e koste e sombugol hollata ko ɓingel ngel heɓaaka sembe sabu rufugo iyam mawngu. Ngam haɗugo ɗum, ko haani ɓingel fu heɓa Vitamin K ɓawo danyugo mum ngam darnugo rufugo iyam e nder sibiti.

question: Myari sobajo amre dubi mako sappo e je tati gam o nasti dango bo wakkati wadi den yotti sibiti mai be hosi mo be godi mo ko handi fu be tawi sembe iyam mako va’i ko handi ni fu be wadan o do danyugo. Oɗon ni har ɓawo aawa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sauri debbo mai o jaɓa ɓe wanna mo sis gam o ɗo der danugo ɗo ni sobajo am saali sam o fiwai o yidi dango baroɓe ibrani enta daga ɓawo o danyi bingal ɓawo aawa sappoi. O ɗo dergo o danyi ɓingel debbo e jamu ko ma min yettore Allah amma ko hirni amni amin ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum be dimbi akai akai mari wuji bandu bingel ɗo o kini amma fofugo wartai dede har dotta be yawi be hokki mo. Oksid likita usini bingel do hisanna be to o hisi o wartan bingal ma wori na fore na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Bingel ngel ina haani yaawde safreede e safrirde ngam famɗgol ƴiiƴam mum e ñawuuji ɓanndu mum, te o heɓa ñaamdu moƴƴundu. Yumma makko ne ina haani safreede ngam sembe ƴiiƴam makko e taƴol ɓernde makko ngam o waawa aawde ɓiyiiko tawa ƴiiƴam yaltataa. So ɓe keɓii safaara moƴƴo, ɓe njaɓɓii sembe, te o rewi laawol kebtingol ngamuuji, omo waawi danyude kadi e nder golle aroyɗe. Kono, sabu omo famɗi dubi sappo e tati, o foti reentaade danygo gila jooni haa ɓanndu mum tiiɗa ngam haɗde bone.

question: Rewo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel herti ɓingel o hakkilinta mai dakka fofata den bo fofugo bingal mai da dedai ba bingal do da keel don ba je be sakkini al ha dango kuma na bingal be yiwata be diyam pewdum. Ɗum waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be ɗofugo mai hoi nai mo bana nane ɗume min waɗata do hala ɗo.
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Ɗofugo e ɓingel petel mo mari diyam pewdum e fofugo ko maande hypoglycemia (sukara ƴiiƴam jippiiɗo) walla rafi malaria, ɗum ko huunde nde hulɓinii no feewi. A foti rokkude ɓingel ngel sukara (glucose) ɗon jippina ɗum e nder ɗoyngel (IV) walla e nder hunuko ngel ngam haɗude ɗofugo ngoo, kadi a sowina ɗum e leɗɗe ngam haɗude ɓuuɓol. A foti rokkude ɗum safaara antibiotics (hano ampicillin) sabu ɓingel petel mari rafi suɗiiɗo, te a yaltina ɓingel ngel to opitaal ngam safroowo ndaara ɗum no feewi. Waɗugo ɗum ɗon haani ko haɗude ɓingel ngel maayde.

question: Debbo fere danyi keccal ha asibiti amin fajiri ɗo dango mai hokkai mo sam o danyi wala damuwa nebai sam ɓawo o dayi min lati leppol min wanni mo ɓuli sofni be iyam ɓawo minti seɗɗa debbo ɗo o naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam. Nyidai sam debbo fuddi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo dane on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danugo dume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata bingel fere don hader redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe daratado ba je debbo do. Duem wawata min wanna debbo ɗo iyam mai dara irin batal ko lekki toi nafu ɗo be min tura debbo ɗo asibiti manga na ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai.
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer: Iyam mai rufa sosai on waddi ko leppol heddiiɗo e nder reedu debbo on, e lekki aada mo o nyami on, ɗum waddi reedu man wanaa waawi ɓillude no haani ngam darnugo iyam. Lekki aada wawata darnugo iyam nde leppol heddii, kadi ina waawi ɓeydude caɗeele walla addude maayde. Ko o hatojini ko safrude e asibiti mawɗo on law ngam yaltinde leppol on e junngo, e rokkude mo lekki darnuki iyam e nder ɓanndu (injection). Woppitu mo lekki aada fere, aarna mo no mo weli, a wurtina mo law asibiti mawɗo on ngam hisnude nguurndam makko.

question: Duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi nyiɓai mi dayi je ɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on midayi mi heriti dou to miɗo musina keccal am ɗo yarnama bani musungo to o musini seddani sei o itta hunduko mako to mi habdi musungo mo fahin sei o musina seɗɗa o itta hunduko sei ko haɗi mo musungo boɗɗum sei mirriti o ɗo mari damba wala fufa boɗɗum bana ɓingel. banninta pofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am o vima den ɗo daya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo minti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min ko ɓuri pusungu amɓerde maanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am wala wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai to mi waɗi sembe to miɗi o musina. Sai to mi vindini mo o musina seɗɗa to fottini mo miɗi mi’ama dow sabo pewol man je o wala fofa be boɗɗum ɗo bofi fu ɗo nanda bana kine mako ɗo sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum.
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Damba e ɓuuɓri ɓawɗiri ndi a jogii e keccel maa ndi, ko maayde ƴiiƴam walla ƴiiƴam ɓawɗam (infection) ummoriide e musungo ngoo. Safaara aada ndi a huutortoo ndi laaɓaani, tee ɗum ɗon waawi ɓeydude ɓuuɓri ndi walla addude maayde ƴiiƴam goɗɗum. A foti yaltinde sifaaji safaara aada ɗii, a yaha e asibiti ngam likita en ɓanngu ɓawɗam ngam, ɓe ndokka ma safaara antibiotik tigi-rigi. To ɓuuɓri ndi ɓanngaaka e safaara asibiti, damba e keccel maa ɗon ɓeydoo, tee a waawi heɓude caɗeele e yahdu maa.

question: Debbo ɗo danyi ha sibiti meɗen lebbi jego ko sali o wari sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi ɓingel marɗo lebbi jego mai wardi be mako jonta dada ma waɗi bayani do o hefti ɓingel man ɗo ɗojja balɗe sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nai ko sali o vi bo o ɗon no hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko ɗojugo man fuɗɗa o vi ɗo jere man halli on daga kiya. taci ko fuddi amma harturti o vide o musini mo fu odo hokka mo lekki ndiyam je dargo je be sorata je dojugo do je o dinki hokkugo bingel man do yara vi daga keya dojugo man turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa be boddum sosai bana pofde man do ta’a on do yaha dow je palas kala wakkati. Ɓe hultiri hanjum madi ɓe waddi mo sibiti meɗen jotta e mol am ha ɗo hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo ɗo ko vallata mo be ɓingel ɗo ha sare na larugo no pofɗe mako ta’ata be ɗojere ɗo min vindina be lekki dojugo na ko en wadda go jego je dow ɓingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko batir.
reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer: A foti jokkugo hokkugo debbo on ndiyam e ɓanndu (IV fluids), hokka mo lekki malaria ɗam ɗon naata e ɓanndu (IV artesunate), e lekki haɗugo fittudu (diazepam) ngam saakugo fittudu maɗum. Ƴeɗu suukara ɓanndu maɗum (blood sugar) e no ɓanndu maɗum heftiri (electrolytes), sabu ƴakkugo ɓanndu (dehydration) ɗon waawi addugo ɗum. Ngam ɓingel man, ƴeɗu so o heɓii ƴakkugo ɓanndu; sabu inna maɗum waawaa yonkugo, yonku ɓingel man be kopo walla cuccal be nono inna maɗum walla lekki ɓingel (formula). Hokku ɓingel man lekki haɗugo malaria, ƴeɗugo nguleeki e pofde maɗum no feewi, waddu ɓe ɗiɗo fuu ɗo ɗon ƴeɗetee haa ɓanndu maɓɓe heɓa jam.

question: Min nyii goto nder rewɓe amin marɓe redu be gorko mako fajil ɗo vis jabur mako be ɓawo mako ɗo nawa be wakkatil mako waɗai fu min emi mo redu mako lebbi noi on o vi lebbi jego be balɗe sedda on min to ɗo nawa mo jotta na ko ɗo wara dilla on sai o vi ɗon jotta sei min emi mo to o larini. Ndiyam ko iyam na ɗo vi o lare ndiyam be iyam min emi mo ko bingel man je lamba noi on bo redu man je noi on vi amin on je arande emol min mari likita man hanjum on do alama debbo yotti on na o fukkiri on na ko hunde fere on min wawan min yarta debbo man dilla ɓe wanna mo koji nder redu wato sk. ngam min anda ko fe’ata na.
reference:
Min yi goto der rewbe Amin marbe redu beh gorko mako fijjiri doh, ovi les jaburu mako beh bawo mako do nawa, beh wakkati daigol mako yottai fuu. Min emimo redu mako lebbi noi on? Ovi lebbi jego beh balde sedda on. Min emimo toh do nawa mo jotta ko do wara dilla on, sei ovi do nawa mo jotta. Sei min emimo toh olari diyam ko iyam, ovi olari diyam beh iyam. Min emimo bo bingel man jeh lamba noi on, bo redu man jeh noi on? Sei ovi hanjum on je arande. Emol min marni likita men hanjum on ; do alama daigol yotti onna, o fukkiri na, ko hunde fere on?
Min wawan min yerba debbo man dilla beh wanna mo gwaji der redu Wato scanning gam min anda ko fe’ata na?
model_answer: Ɗum ɗon holla wonde debbo on no mari jippagol redu (uterine prolapse) walla huunde heddiinde nder redu sabu ƴiiƴam man ɗon arda so o dillii. A foti artirde mo to likita ngam o waɗa ƴeewndorgol nder redu (pelvic exam) e ultrasound ngam anndude ko heddii walla so redu mako jippii. Woppitu o lara ndiyam e iyam, sabu ɗum wallataa e nder redu, ɗum no waawi ɓeydude bone. Haa o heɓa safara, o foti ɗon wotta, o woppa dille tedduɗe ngam haɗde redu mako jippude ɓuri heewde. Likita on tan waawi anndude so o hatojini safara walla operation ngam feewnude ɗum.

question: titi lola daga ɓandu bingel am do fita diuna bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam don nanda ma bana dande bingel man metatatata wailutuggo gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo dume on wawata godda zazzabi do be bo ko hadata dande mako golto handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sabo zazzabi man be ko hadata dande mako watuggo jawabu toy be yeccata men je ko woyla bandu bingel man je wadata zazzabi be ko hadata mako wanko.

Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.

model_answer: Bingel man no mari alamaaji rafi tiiɗɗo bana zazzabi tiiɗɗo walla rafi hakkille, o haani o yaha asibiti hannde hannde. Nguleeki ɓandu ko alamaari rafi wonaa sabu rafi on, sabu ko ñawu baɗɗo e ƴiiƴam walla hakkille wadi ɗum. A wadataa safrude mo e galle walla a rokkata mo tan dawa zazzabi, a foti ko doginde mo yaake e nokku cellal ɓurɗo ɓadtaade on. So bingel wawataa wailitaade dande mum, no fusa fusa, te gite mum no wila, ɗum no holla wonde rafi on no tiiɗi no feewi haa yotti hakkille. Yahu asibiti ɗon ɗon ngam heɓude pooki e ƴeewndal laaɓtungol ngam hisnude ngurdan bingel man.

question: Dada fere hakkili lari ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja je balɗi arindiri kamma pewol on ɓillata ɓerde ɓingel man den bo accan mo amma bo ɗo juko man usta ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam ɗojara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bano o wala wawa fufa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini bingal man darni oɗo wawan nano ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati fufata ngam bannin ango. Ɓingel man nda ɓingel man ɗoji sosai ha gagiri mo fufugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tas yahugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo pofɗe man nden nde bo o anda hedi o wawata valliugo emwal amma ha ɗo kanjum on ɗume on wawata wadda ɗojere be tawol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma. Alluhai handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man ɗo ɗoja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man ngam usta ko haɗa ɗojugo man.
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Fufugo sosai, ɗujugo, be fiyugo ɓerde ɗo ɓingel man hollata wonde o heɓii fukka ɓerde (pneumonia) walla pewol tiiɗngol. A foti nawrude ɓingel man asibiti jooni-jooni sabu fufugo sosai ko maande hulluɓinde nde wanaa safaara suudu tan waawi safrude. Likita'en ɓen ndokkan ɓingel man safaara antibiyotik e oksijen so o haajii ngam safrude fukka ɓerde man. Haa a yottoo asibiti, a waawi rokkude mo paracetamol ngam ustugo hakkili man. Leelinaa, nawru mo asibiti ngam hoto ɓerde man ɓeydoo tiiɗude haa o maɓɓit.

question: Roowo ɓingel lari ɓingel mai ɗo ɗodda sosai naudum har karshe doddugo bingel none don wadata dotugo ha bingel bannin tan har karshe doddugo mai wala fufa boddum da kerdake fofata goji dume be dume be wawata be wanna bingal to borade toi min hokkata mo be kuma chawara tokkata reo bingal mai.
reference:
Renoodo bingel lari bingel mai do dojja sosai naudum, har karshe dojjugo mingel nonnon tan foofugo daker.

Kuma shawara toi hokkata renoodo bingel mai?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ina heɓi yoori ɓanndu (dehydration) mawndi sabu suddi e wuddugol walla tayre (malaria) tiiɗɗo, ɗum waɗi a foti yahrude makko e opitaal ɗon e ɗon tawa a rokkataa mo ndiyam e hunuko sabu omo ɗaɓɓi. To opitaal, safrooɓe ɓee mbaɗat mo safaara naatirteeɗo e ɓanndu (IV fluids) hono Normal Saline ngam artirde ɓanndu makko e semmbe. Ɓe mbaɗat mo safaara tuubaaɗe (IV medications) hono Artesunate ngam tayre, e Antibiotics (Ceftriaxone) ngam haɗude rafiiji goɗɗi. Ɓe ustat nguleeki makko, te ɓe ndewat e ƴeewtaade semmbe makko haa o heɓa cellal. Hoto ɗaɓɓu safaara e galle sabu ɗum ko rafi mawɗo, yahrude makko e opitaal ko kañum tan woni laawol ngam hisnude nguurndam makkel.

question: nonon tan min lari debbo rediyo je sibiti amin wari fajjiri do o wari be naudum sosai o do woka be sembe odo jogi bawo mako be redu mako gam nodum o nanata bawo minti jetati yahugo sappo ha dar sudu danyugo min waddi mo min lari mo min tawi bingel do jippa. dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.

model_answer: Ɗum ko rafi preeclampsia tiiɗɗo (severe preeclampsia) mo rafi iyam ɓurtuɗam fittude caggal danyigo (PPH) jillondiri, ko ɗum addani mo nyamugo hoore, gite makko nji'ataa, e waasude sembe. A foti fuɗɗaade rokkude mo Magnesium Sulfate ngam haɗude ɗum fawde (convulsions) e ustude ɓilɓilndo hoore, e rokkude mo Oxytocin ngam dartinde iyam ngam. Ƴeewto ɓilɓilndo hoore makko, no o fiyrata ɓernde, e no o yaltinta ndiyam (urine) kala hojom haa o sellia.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam fewɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Mi faami wonande ɓingel maa petel ki fofata no moƴƴi wonaa daidai, ki hirlita, kuma ki fofa doole (rapid breathing). Ɗum ina wadda ki maara koyngal ko dow yiwugo ndiyam maKaka moƴƴa – ɗum ina waawi laarugo asma (asthma), pneumonia, walla ko ɓernde muusu (heart problem).

**Ko foti waɗeede jooni:**
1. Yaaru ɓingel maa lopital walla clinic law-law – ɗum wonaa ko fadata, sabu fofugo doole ina waawi wonugo tanaa mawɗo.
2. Jaɓ ɓe ɓe laara ɓingel: ɓe hebbina oksijin (oxygen) so ina himmi, ɓe laara wonaa pneumonia walla asma.

Bingel dubi joy be zebbi didi be godo (kilanga wootere), ko woni jarrabi kanjum:

**Ko waddata woytaare/duggugo (jemma be nyalooma):**
- **Tibi (asthma) walla bronchiolitis** - waccugo be duggugo dow, be balbal walla RSV
- **Pneumonia** - dogngal, wutteende, duggugo saɗɗugo
- **Tibi kaddi (whooping cough/pertussis)** - waccugo dow-dow, be duggugo saɗɗugo jemma; ndeke hebi jarraba mo be antibiotic (azithromycin)

**Ko waddata woytaare/damuwa be sadingo jemma:**
- **GERD (ndiyam reedu artan)** - reedu artan, waddata duggugo be woytaare, saɗɗugo jemma
- **Otitis media (tibi noppi)** - noppi laarat, waccugo, damuwa
- **Fofugo saɗɗugo (nasal congestion)** - waddata duggugo be jemma

Ko foti waɗeede:
1. **Yaltina mo do**, ndaaru weight, respiratory rate, be O2 saturation
2. **Ndaaru noppi be daande** be otoscope
3. **Chest X-ray** so hebi walla pneumonia laari
4. So tibi kaddi (pertussis) - waɗ **azithromycin** be laaru bevi goɗɗi
5. So GERD - **elevate** bingel nde muusa, jarrab feeding smaller amounts, ndaaru so alaa danger signs

**Danger signs foti yaaɗugo hospital hesde:** duggugo saɗɗugo, ndiyam ɓittugo, cyanosis (buluu), fita nyaamugo, walla temperature ɓeydii.

Kilanga wootere (single dose) antibiotic mi hokki alaa sabu; foti tafirde correct diagnosis. Yaltinde bingel be jarrab kombeteeje.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
Mi yi‘i ko mama maaccake fu: ɓingel ngel diwi balɗe tati (3 days), ɗum ɗo woli, ɗon somina sosai, ɗon rufa iyam kosɗe be juɗe mako, be ɓandu mako ɗon huɓɓa. Ɗum fu ko maannoune **severe dehydration** (iyam sosinaki e ɓandu) ɗon iwa e conjol be rufugo iyam (diarrhea). Ko woni feere maggo ko yaawgo yaha asibiti walla clinic, sabu ɓingel mai wawi luttinde iyam sanne, ɗum wawi warde mo.

Ko likita waɗata: hokka ngel **ORS** (Oral Rehydration Salt — iyam njoornowal, sukkar be lamɗam) be **Zinc** balɗe 10-14; so ɓingel ɗon jaɓa liɓugo, laarat mo be **IV fluids** (iyam ɓoggol) haa iyam artira e ɓandu maggo. Wakkati ndeen fu, dumtu ɓingel ɗon muynina walla ɗon nyaamna, ta accu ngel dogata, e laarat toɓɓere conjol ndeen (bacterial walla viral) ngam eɓɓaade lekki lawɗinɗo tan so ɓe njiɗi.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. model_answer:
Narange ɓinge man mo lewru jetati (7 lebbi) mari mo, alamuuji ɗi a wowi ɗi—tarihi keccel jemma, habugo, fofa be bone, lari be haɗa ɗanugo—ana holli iwol koje **colic** maa reflux (acid reflux) walla gaas nder reedu.

**Ko haani a waɗa:**
- Narange o ndaɗɗina, ndaɗɗin mo hakkunde ɗum walla ɓaawo ɗum, tafa mo dow becce maa kore mabbe ha o wurta gaas (burping) ɗuuɗɗum.
- Woto ndaɗɗin o defa mo yeeso o daɗɗoo—hokku mo lewru ndaɗɗina/kosam hakkunde daɗɗino.
- To a defay mo be biberon, hokkuɓe biberon mo yuɓɓol daɗɗino ɓuri ustaa ngaas.

**Ko waɗta a yaha likita law:** to o daɗɗike ɗanude, wutta ɗanugo (vomiting) katan katan, alamuuji ɗanugo maa buurugo, walla o alli ɗanude—ɗum ana wallita likita andugo si wonaa colic tan.

Colic timmata mo hitaande jeegom-jeeɗiɗi lebbi, wonaa ñabbu bonɗu, kono ɗanude keccel be nafooje ana walli.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:

question: nonnon tan min laari debbo reduje je sibiti amin wari fajiri ɗo o wari be nauɗum sosai o ɗo hoka be sembe o ɗo jogi ɓawo mako be redu mako ngam nonɗum o nanata ɓawo minti jetati yahugo sappo haa nder sudu dayugo min waddi mo min laari mo min tawi ɓingel ɗo jippa pellel dayugo ɗi neeɓai sam o dayi ɓingel debbo to min waddi ni ko haandi fu en waɗata ɓawo redujo dayi neeɓai ni min hoosi dada be ɓingel maako min jari ɓe har suudu ɓe siwtata de neeɓi seɗɗa sai dada mai yoni amin o yoni amin o yecci amin o ɗo nana o wala sembe o nana o somi gite maako o yi'ata laɓɗum o wi'a amin o goodi yamugo ɓaawo o dayi amma daker o heɓi o yami be yiri may wala jippa boɗɗum har jotta o ɗo dana o wala sembe be o fuɗɗi nanugo gilol ɗime on fe'i bannin ko yi'am vurti ha maako sosai o wala yi'am o handi ni ka ko o handi ni kaɓilungo yi'am ko ɗume wadanta mo min hokka mo yi'am naa ko min hokka mo nyiri

model_answer: Ko waddi mo ɗum ko yi’am ɓaawo daygo (postpartum hemorrhage) ngam sembe reedu walaa malla heddiiɗum nder reedu. Maande makko (gite somi, yi’ataa laɓɗum, nanugo gilol ɗime, wala sembe) holli o walaa yi’am haa ɓanndu, o ɗon nder shock. Ngam hisnugo yonki makko, min poti hokkude mo yi’am (blood transfusion) naa nyiri tan, ngam nyiri timminataa yi’am majjum jaawɗum. model_answer: Rawandu ɓingel maaɗa fuɗɗii namputure e uurnude sabo taƴuki babal e lekki gargajiya naastini nyawu bakitiriya (infeksiyon ɓalli). model_answer: A jaaraama, Titilola.
