question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: A jabbii, mi nani haala ma. Ɓingel maa ɗon mari ɓalndu som-somi, fewi e nguleeki e juuɗe e kosɗe nder balɗe tati—ɗum waawi wonde nyawu sikol-sel (sickle cell dactylitis) malla infekson mawnɗo ba wayi no selulitis. Min ƴeewoyma ɓandu maako, mbaɗen testi ƴiiƴam (kala e sikol-sel) ngam andugo goonga; jaawɗum e lekki (antibiyotik e leɗɗe goɗɗe) ina wooda. E dow maa, iyyam rufata ɓaawo danygol balɗe tati ɗum huunde haani hakkilanki; mi hokkante lekki haɗuki iyyam (misal, tranexamic acid) e vitamin/iron ngam sembe. Nden min ngada kuuɗe toppitagol haa a e ɓingel maa njamndu. Amin.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Meningitis (nyawu meternal ɓernde) waawi wonde sabaabu ɗum: keccel ɓingel maa wokan e tawi bana bone, salii musinoowo e fooftaago, e tari ummotoongo e koyɗe haa to hoore. Ɗum wi’etee ko bone caɗtuɗo, ɓingel maa haani law yahde to asibiti mawngu. Tiiɗno e ɓernde, ɓe mbaawan waɗde jarrabawol ƴiiƴam ɓaawo ngam anndude sifaaji e fuɗɗaade lekki maro haɓɓuki (antibiotics) law. To a leeli, meningitis waawi waɗde hasre heewaɗe. Ngartam e hakkille: ɗaɓɓita laawol safrirde e dow yaawre, ngam hisnugo ɓingel maa.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam fewɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Alamaaji ɗi a tawi haa ɓingel ngel, bana fofugo dakkere bee doojol wakkati fuu, ɗon holla ɓingel ngel heɓi nyaw pempal (pneumonia) ko nyaw pewuri masiin nder ɓokkooji (lungs). Nyaw man ɗon hebbina ɓokkooji fofo bee ndiyam ko mbordi, ɗum wadi fofugo ɓingel ngel saɗti, ngel ɗon fofa bee tikkere ngam ngel heɓa henndu daidai. Ngam Allah taa fasa, doggu yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti dakkol maaɗa jotta-jotta ngam likita'en ndaara ngel. Haa asibiti, ɓe hokkan ngel lekki kuneeli (antibiotics) malla ɓe ɓasna ngel henndu (oxygen) ngam ɓingel ngel heɓa fofugo sika bana nane. Taa jooɗa haa saare a naata hujjakuuji asali, ngam nyaw pempal ɗon mbarugo ɓikkoi pettoi law to ɓe keɓai magani wakkati.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe wanna mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na

Ko saabi ɓingel ngel waawaa fofugo boɗɗum woni neeɓugo nder daƴugo, hawtade e sembe iiyam inna maagel ɗum ɓe tawi ɗon, ɗum waɗi fofaango (oxygen) yahaai nder ngaandi e ɓanndu ɓingel ngel nder reedu.

Amma, doole likita'en tokka kakkilanngo e lura bee ɓingel ngel boɗɗum nder balɗe seɗɗa yeeso ngam tabbitinki cellal maagel, kadi ɓe ndaara magani sembe iiyam sobajo ma ɗon.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer:
Nyaw fuka (asthma) koo bo mura pewuri goriije pofɗe (pneumonia) on ɓuri waddugo irin dojjere nden be ta'ol pofɗe, musamman ma nder jamma. 

Kuje kalluɗum ɗe handi on hakkila laara kanci on to ɓingel ɗo fofa ɓernde ɗo loha nder (chest indrawing), tonndu ɗo waɗa bulu-bulu, koo to o waawaa yarugo ndiyam e ɗanugo. 

Ngam ustugo koo haɗugo dojjere nden, resdu ɓingel man daga peewol, kuraare, curki yiite koo turare moskito, e urdiji ɗi uurngo majjum saati. 

Yahugo asibiti lawlaw ɗo nafata sosai ngam ɓingel man ɗo haaji magani pofɗe (nebulizer) koo iska nyawɓe (oxygen) ngam goriije pofɗe mako maɓɓita o fofa be boɗɗum. 

Tokku umroore likita'en dow maaganiiji ɗi ɓe hokki mo, nden bo on laara ɗaakiji e nokkuuje ɗe o waalata ɗo laɓɓi taa nyaw man warta.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Nyawu ngu ɓingel maaɗa mari woni paɓɓooji (convulsion) ɗi wuludu ɓanɗu caatungu addata, ɗum boo alama nyawu pabboje koo jontere laaɓere (severe malaria) koo nyawu ɓoggi hoore (meningitis). 

Lekki gargajiya e sabulu leɗɗe wawaa yamɗintingo nyawu ngu'u, naftirgo ɗum boo ɗon ɓesda bone har ɓingel waawa rasugo yonki mum. 

Ngam ndiyam koo nguufo ɗam ɗon wurtoo haa hunduko maagel e moɗugo tiiɗi, to lumbu ngel koo dume nder hunduko ngam taa ɗum maɓɓa foofngo (airway) maagel ngel faɗɗe. 

Yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti bangaaro jooni-jooni ngam likit'en ndokka ngel bammbe (injections) nyawndata paɓɓooji, usta wuludu ɓanɗu, e mballa ngel heɓa foofngo. 

To a doggi bee ɓingel asibiti lawlaw heɓi laccitki jamanu (modern treatment), ngel heɓan dama, ngel yamɗa cuka.

model_answer: Sannu ma, tunda gwaji holli o wala nyau TB (Tibi), duggugo be duko fofugo je sadinta mo musamman wakkati jemma dum alama nyau asma (asthma). Nonnon tan min lari debbo redujo je sibiti amin wari fajiri do. Owari be naudum sosai, odo wooka be sembe, odo jogi baawo mako be reedu mako gam noudum onanata. Bawo minti je tati yahugo sappo hader sudu 
dayugo min waddimo. Min larimo mintawi , mingel do jippa pellel danugo Dee. Nebai sam o dayi mingel debbo.
Toh min wadi ni kohaadi fu enwadata bawo redugo dayi .
Napai ni min hosi daada be bingel mako, min yari be haa sudu be suitata.
De nebi sedda, sai daada mai yooni amin , o yechi amin odonana o wala sembe, osomi , gite mako oyiyata labdum.
Ovi amin fu ogodi yamugo bawo o Dayi, amma dakar o hebi o yammi, Be yiiri mai wala jibba boddum.
Har jotta odonana o walaa sembe be ofuddi nanugo giilol . 
Dime on fedi bannin? Ko eyam vurti ha maako sosai, owala eyam. Ohadinika pillunko eyam. Ko dime bewadantamo? 
Min hokkamo eyam na?
Ko min hokkamo yirri?
model_answer: Nyawu ngu debbo on heɓi woni wurtaaki ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗɗam ɓaawo danygol (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ngam danygol maako yaawi masin, ɗum waɗi o ɗon sirta ƴiiƴam har o waasi sembe. Giilol, niɓɓaaki gite, bee laafu nguu ɗon holla ƴiiƴam ɓanndu maako uyti sosai har o nasta haala bone yonki (hypovolemic shock). Taa on mbadi anniya hokkugo mo nyiiri wakkatiire nden; ko o ɓuri haaje lawlaw woni ndiyam lekki (IV fluids) bee lekki taƴoojum ƴiiƴam bana oxytocin. Ngam o sirti ƴiiƴam ɗuuɗɗam har o waalaa sembe sam, eey o haandi o loowe ƴiiƴam (blood transfusion) lawlaw koo yonki maako hisa. Ha asibitiji amin, taƴugo ƴiiƴam bee loowugo ƴiiƴam kesam woni ko ɓuri himmugo wakkati bana nii, naa hokkugo nyiiri, ngam hisnugo inna on.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Sannu ma, bana likitaajo miɗo tabbitina ma dow haala ndiyam nasti hoore ɓingel ngal dada gorko ma wi'i waalaa, ko waddi ɗum kine keccel ma on sukki, kanjum waddi o waawataa foofaago boo o musina wakkati gooto. Ɓikkon keccoy kine maɓɓe tan ɓe foofirta, ngam maajum to majje sukki bee nduufa koo pewol, ɓe nufata nufaali boo ɓe ittan hunduko maɓɓe daga enndu ngam ɓe heɓa ɓe foofira hunduko. Ngam wallugo mo, roottu toɓɓe ndiyam enndu ma bee maada koo bo magani ndiyam kine (normal saline drops) nder kine maako ngam ɗum ɗaata nduufa man, ngam o heɓa damaraw foofaago wakkati o musinata. Ɗum sifa masalaaji ɓurnɗi heewgo haa asibitiji meeɗen dow keccoy, ngam maajum taa tinnu, wurtin nduufa man seɗɗa-seɗɗa boo a fakkito o heɓa nguleeki boɗɗum haa ɓanndu maako. Ammaa, to a yi'i ɓanndu maako ɗon wuli, o salake musingo sam, koo boo oɗon foofa bee sembe haa gabaare maako ɗon loha (chest indrawing), waddumo asibiti lawlaw ngam a fura.

model_answer:
Alamaaji ɗi on mbii ɗon holla masibo mawngo, bana danygol ngol wakkati muudum yottaaki ko boo saaro ɓingel taƴi (abruptio placentae), ngam o ɗon yi'a diyam bee i'yam tawi reedu ndun lebbi jeego'o tan. 

Taa on yerbu, taa on moosu, kadi taa on nyo'u reedu maako sam, ngam ɗum waawan warugo ɓingel ngel ko wadda zubuɓo i'yam mbardam inna on. 

Nder gandal amin, naawol reedu tokkindirngol bee wurtaago i'yam e diyam haa reedu ndu yottaaki ɗum haala cattuɗum (emergency) ɗum waawataa safreede nder saare. 

On dilla bee maako asibiti mawngo jooni-jooni to likita'en mbaawi lartugo mo bee masin (scan) ngam faamugo ko woni masibo man, ɓe walla mo. 

Kuucee asibiti lawlaw ngam on mbaawa hisnugo yonki debbo on bee ɓiɗɗo maako arandeejo on.

model_answer: Sannu ma Titi Lola, alamaji ɗi ɓiɗɗo ma holli bana zazzabi, daande faggunde (stiff neck) e yitere nde maɓɓataako, ɗon nandi bee nyawu masiin nguu ɓe ewnata "Meningitis" (pewuri ngaandi). Nyawu man ɗon heewi nder lesdi meeɗen wakkati nguleeki, bo ɓingel ma haandi heɓa alluuje (antibiotics) nder ƴiiƴam lawlaw ngam hisnugo yonki mako.

question: rawandu gati bingel banɗan dubi mako jeɗiɗi de rawandu mai gati mo e yahi ha gargajiya goddo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum a foro amma jonta babal rawandu mai gati fuɗɗi wurtugo namputure bo ɓuti e yecci ɓe yara mo asibiti useni iri kalariroye toy e wannata ɓingel ɗo o wawan heɓugo wutandu gam rawandu may koda rawandu may ɗo dama bo iri sabandi toy hani e wanna ɓingel petel ɗo mandoro wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako
reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? Owawan heɓugo wuttaandu gam rawaandu mai, ko da rawaandu mai ɗo daama? Bo iri safande toi haani ewanna ɓingel peetel ɗo? Maandu rawaandu mai wannai mo illa fere ha ɓandu mako.
model_answer:
Mbordi (namputure) e ɓuuɗu ɗu holli wulnde nden heɓi nyawu (infection) ngam lekki gargajiya ki ɓe waati; yaaru ɓingel asibiti lawlaw ngam likitaajo wogga wulnde nden bo hokka mo lekki antibiotics. 

Ee, ɓingel ngel waawan heɓugo nyawu wutandu koo to rawandu ndu ɗon laaroo jam, ngam nyawu ngu ɗon ɓooya nder ɓandu bako ngu wurtina alaamaaji haa rawandu ndun. 

Loote wulnde nden bee ndiyam doggayɗam e saabulu koo ngoya, ammaa saabulu boɗeejum koo saabulu Dettol ɓuri wooɗugo ngam mbarugo kurkutuuji, nden ɗum wannataa ɓandu ɓingel koo seɗɗa. 

To on njottake asibiti, likitaajo fukkay mo allura wutandu (Anti-Rabies Vaccine) bee allura tetanos ngam hisnugo yonki mako, ngam nyawu wutandu walaa lekki to ngu fuɗɗi wurtugo. 

Taa meɗe naftirgo bee lekki gargajiya haa wulnde rawandu ngati fahin, ngam ɗum ɗon maɓɓa kurkutuuji nyawu nder ɓandu wadda caɗeele maapindiije.

model_answer: Alaamaaji ɗi kaaludaa, irin luutugo yimɓe, salugo nyamdu, e accugo fijiiji, ɗon holla nyawu mettol ɓernde mawngo (depression) malla torra hakkilo mawnge naati mo. Diga jotta, e woodi haaje on koya mo asibiti o fotti bee likitaajo anduɗo nyawuuji hakkilo (psychiatrist) malla baɗoowo shawara ngam o heɓa ballal e lekki kaandi.

reference:
Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.
Ovi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda. 
Ovi dojjere man halli on daga keya. Balde tati ko fuddi amma har turti.
Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu. 
Beh hultiri hanjum wadi beh waddi mo sibiti meden. 
Jotta emol am hado hanjum on; min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo beh bingel do ha saare na? Larugo no pofde mako ta’ata beh dojjere do?
Min vindina be lekki dojjugo na? Ko en wada gwaje-gwaje dau bingel man hiddeko min hokka mo lekki ko bate?
model_answer:
Taa lildube saare bee lekki dojjere, ngam bingel ngel don wondi bee nyawu mangu je 'severe pneumonia' (nyawu pofefofe) dow no bofde maagel ta'oto nasta nder. 

Naste ngel haa suudu nyawbe (admit) lawlaw ngam ngel heba wallende pofngo (oxygen), nden kadi bade goje-goje (X-ray) bana a wi'i ngam tabbitingo no nyawu man wa'i haa gaggawal maagel. 

Dojjere balde sappo e nayi bee fofngo saddungo haa bingel lebbi jeego'o, alama laabɗo on hollaago ngel haani hebugo lekki (IV antibiotics) nder ƴiiƴam lawlaw. 

Hada dada maagel hokkugo ngel lekki damba malla lekki nder gora feere fuu, ngam ɗum waawan ɓeydugo sadda nyawu man malla ma faɗɗa bingel ngel fofugo. 

Hokke ngel kakkilango haa asibiti jooni-jooni haa ngel waawa fofugo boddum hiddeko on lilda ɓe saare.

model_answer: Alaamaaji ɗi ɓingel ma holli, bana doccugo naawngol haa fofaango ɗon maɓɓa (daker-daker) ɓaawo doccugo, ɗon holla alhaali nyaw dojjol bojel (Whooping cough) ngol kwayaaji nyawndi (bacteria) ngaddata. Shawara am haa renowo ɓingel, wakkilan yaara ngel asibiti lawlaw, ngam maɓɓaango fofaango ɗon waawi warugo ɓingel to ngel heɓay wallende law. Kadi boo, tabbitin ɓingel ɗon yara ndiyam bee neemaaji booɗɗum, moostin ngel daga cuurki yite koo taba, nden laara ngel timmini alluraaji rigaakafi (vaccines) maggel fuf ngam faddaago nyawuuji irin ɗi.

Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer:
Mrs. Akinleye, alaamuuji gorko maaɗa ɗii ɗon holla omo woodi asma malla nyawu "allergy" (ko ɓanndu jaɓataa) ɗum sollare e cuurɗe umminta. 

Ɗum ɗon waɗa ngam ɓohe fofugo maako ɗon ɓuuta bo ɗon maɓɓa to o fooɗi sollare malla cuurɗe, naa ngam naywugo woni sababu ɗum waɗata ba. 

Laawol maako ngol ɓuri faa'ida wakkatiire ndee, o reena hoore maako bee jooɗaago haa nokkuuje mari sollare malla cuurɗe ngam taa ɗum ummina isrugo e ta'ugo fofugo man. 

O haandi o yaha asibiti ngam likita'en mbetta mo, ɓe ndokka mo lekki pam-pam (inhaler) malla hapiiji wallata fofugo maako warta daidai. 

To o tokki ndaareeki likita bo o dilli jooɗaago pellel sollare e cuurɗe, o waawan jooɗaago jam bee fofugo belɗum koo toy o woni.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Nyawu ngu nangi ɓingel ngel woni diwoje gulɗum ɓandu (febrile convulsion), wari ngam zazzabi mangi nangi ɓandu maako, bo ɗum ɓuri warugo ngam nyawu *malaria* addanta ɓikkoi ɗum. 

Hakkiilo ki dada foti waɗugo wakkati may woni, o leliya ɓingel ngel dow seengo (wakkude) ngam taa o maama foofugo, kadi o ɓorta mo limse tekkuɗe ngam gulɗum ɓandu usta. 

Taa o fasa nyi'e ɓingel ngel malla o watta koo ɗume nder hunduko maako wakkati o waɗata jonɗo majum ngam taa o maama. 

Taa o jogga ɓingel ngel doole wakkati o dimbata ngam taa yi'e maako keloo. 

Daga ɗon, o wulla lawlaw o yara ɓingel ngel asibiti yeeso likita'en ngam ɓe ndaara mo, ɓe ndokka mo magani *malaria* be zazzabi ngam taa ɗum lorso.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Debbo ɗo ɗon wondi be rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage), ko ɓuri waddata ɗum kanjum on reedu salugo taarugo, kedde saal heddaago nder reedu, tayugo laawol danyugo, koo bo woodgo ɓingel feere nder reedu ngel danyaaka. 

A jaawnu a wanna mo ndiyam *drip* (IV fluids) ngam sembe maako lora, nden a fukka mo batal *Oxytocin* koo a hokka mo kwayaaji *Misoprostol* ngam reedu maako taaro, iyam mai dara. 

Bawo ɗon, a mooya reedu maako (massage) bee sembe, nden a laara nder ngam a tabbitina walaa kedde saal koo ɓingel feere heddi. 

To iyam mai sali darugo ɓawo a waɗi ɗiɗo fuu, a tura mo lawlaw yaari asibiti manga ngam ɓe ɓesda mo iyam, ɓe hisna yonki maako. 

Waɗugo ɗum lawlaw ɗon nafa sosai nder asibitiiji gureeli amin, ngam rufugo iyam ɗuuɗɗam ɗon wadda dullaare (shock) bee maayde lawlaw haa rewɓe danyoɓe.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer: Sannu Titilola, alamoji ɗi a limti, bana zazzaɓi, diwugo, e dande tiiɗugo haa haɗa wailugo, ɗon holla ɓingel ma ɗon mari nyawu mboɗu hoore (Meningitis) koo nyawu pabbooje tiiɗuɗum (Severe Malaria). Nyawu ngu ɗon waɗa ɓuuɓri nder ɓaande ngaandi hoore e ƴi'e ɓaawo, kanjum waddata zazzaɓi jawɗum, haɗata dande wailugo, e shafugo ɓokko-ɓokkooji waɗa gite maɓɓataako. Yaaru ɓingel man asibiti mangu (General Hospital koo Federal Medical Centre) wakkati oon tigi, ngam likita'en mbaɗa gwaji ndiyam ɓaawo mako (Lumbar puncture) ɓe annda daliila maajum. To ɓe anndi daliila man, ɓe piyan mo alluhaaje caɗɗe e safaara nder ƴiiƴam (IV medications) ngam hisnugo yonki mako. Taa neeɓu nder saare sam, ngam ɗum nyawu mangu waddata naawallaaji dindima koo maayde to asibiti yaaretaake jaw-jaw.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Ɗum masibo mangum je ɓawo danyugo bi'eteɗum *Postpartum Hemorrhage* (rufugo iyam masin ɓawo danyugo), kanci on waɗi ɓingel ma sooyi iyam sosai ha ɓandu mako fewi, o ɗon diwna, bo o laɓi tas ngam iyam yari ha ɓandu mako. Dalila rufugo iyam mai ɗo wawa latugo saabi taari (placenta) koka heɗooji luttai ha nder danga ɓingel, koka danga mai matitaayi (contract) no haandi, ɗum bo hanjum faddata iyam mai darugo. Bana likitaajo, aniya am wakkati mai kanjum on mi lota nder danga mako ngam mi ittita ko luttai nder fuu, kadi mi hokkamo lekki sembe ki ɗarnata iyam mai lawlaw. Ngam iyam rufi masin har o somi sosai, o ɗon nandi e naunugo ndiyam ɓandu (IV fluids) e ɓesdaari iyam lawlaw (blood transfusion) ngam hisnugo yonki mako e lornitugo sembe mako. To o heɓi kulle ɗe'e e lekkiji ɓesdudi iyam, ɓandu mako wawan wartugo jam wakkati seɗɗa ngam o wawa hakkilgo be ɓingel mako boɗɗum.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tarihi mangi he jemma, fofugo be lawlaw, e salugo musnugo nder keccel lewru jeetati ɗo hollita alama nyau pofu nawngu (severe pneumonia) koo bo mura ɓittuka (bronchiolitis). Nyau man ɗo hebbina pofu ɓingel be daam, ɗum waɗa ɓingel habda be fofugo, woka ɓawo tari, bo rawa heɓugo sembe fijugo koo ɗanugo jemma. Salugo musnugo e fofugo be bone ɗo alamaaji kulol masin (danger signs), ɗum hollata ɓingel man don haa hasare nden o haandi o heɓa wallende asibiti lawlaw. Likita hokkan ɓingel man lekki mbara kooti (antibiotics), e hendu (oxygen) to ɗon haaje, ngam mboɗɗina laawol hendu mako o waawa fofugo. A waɗi boɗɗum waddigo mo asibiti lau; accu likita'en puɗɗa kuuɗe maɓɓe ngam ɓingel ma heɓa afiya, fofa boɗɗum, bo o waawa ɗanugo.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam fewɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
Ko waddata ɓingel maada fofugo da kerɗum bee dojjugo saajo-saajo ɗum jonte ɓalndu (pneumonia) bee peewol ɓalndu (hypothermia) saabe yiwugo mo bee ndiyam fewɗum, bikkon danyaakon bako yotta wakkati (premature) ɗon yaafa heɓugo ɗum. 

Aachee yiwugo ɓingel man bee ndiyam fewɗum pat, nden njoortee mo mboɗɗum haa dow kirke baaba walla daada (Kangaroo Mother Care) ngam o heɓa ɗowndi nden peewol lesta. 

Dakkere fofata bee fofugo law-law ɗo alaamaaji masiibo mawɗum on haa ɓikkon peetoy je waawi addtogo maide mada. 

Yahee asibiti njaulan ɗon-ɗon ngam likita'en korta mo, mballa mo bee fofugo (oxygen) bee safareeji jonte ɓalndu bako sela.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe wanna mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Ɓingel ɗon mari damuwa fofugo ngo ɓe biyata *birth asphyxia* saabu o neeɓi nder daƴugo ngam gorko man sali waɗugo siyas (CS) wakkati haandi. Hisugo mako e no o wartirta jamo fu ɗon fawa dow no o luttiri wala fofugo e to oxygen yottii ngaandi mako boɗɗum wakkati man. To oxygen yottaai ngaandi mako boɗɗum wakkati o ɗon neeɓa nder daƴugo, ɗum waawan addango mo mboosaangu ngaandi (cerebral palsy) ko damuwa jonde mako yeeso. Jotta, ɗum ɗon yiɗi likita'en sukaayel (paediatricians) lanya mo sosai nder babal sukaayel lollungal (SCBU) ngam hokkugo mo lekkiiji e oxygen haa o heɓa sella. Min ɗon du'ano mo, amma doole on tokko linyol likita'en ngam tabbanugo hisugo mako e jahargal mako yeeso e jam.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.
Amma bo, dojjugo man ustai. Bingel man do umma kala jamma fu gam dojjere man. Wakkati go kam ma bingel man do hapda bana o wala wawa fofa beh boddum. Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. De bingel man dojji Sosai ha gagiri mo fofugo beh boddum der jamma, jango man dada man taski yahugo asibiti. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Kuje kalludum toi handi beh hakkila beh man toh bingel man do dojja? Kujeji toi handi beh hakkila beh man gam usta ko hada dojjugo man?
model_answer: Ɗojjuru bee caatal fofugo jemma ɗo, ɗum kuuje nannduɗe bee pige-pewol (asthma) malla nanngeego keeci (chest infection) ngam laabi fofugo ɓiyum man ɓilli mbuubaaje. Peewol jemma, nduudi, e cuurki yiite walla taba ɗon ɓeyda ɓillugo laabi fofugo man haa o fuɗɗa dojjo bee jemma. Alaamaaji lanngeefi (danger signs) ɗi mboɗon kaandi kuɗa ngoni: fofugo jaawɗum sanne, siɓungo keeci (chest indrawing), malla to hunduko makko fuɗɗi ɓawluggo (cyanosis). Ngam ustaggo ɗum, laccu ɓiyum man diga nduudi, cuurki, e peewol jemma, nden mballaa mo o ɗanna bee jooɗnde seeɗa (propped up). Jaago asibiti jango ɗon mari nafa sanne ngam likitoci ndaara mo, mballa mo bee lekkiiji fofugo boɗɗum.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti

Ta waddu ko ɗume ha hunduko maako ngam o wawaa moɗugo jotta, nden ɗum ɗon lora hisgo mako. Yaaru ɓingel man asibiti maza jotta ngam o heɓa wallitoo bee lekkiiji mardɗi dama diga lekto'en.

model_answer:
Ko waɗi debbo ɗon woni jippol maako (placenta) jippaki booɗɗum, ɗum waɗi o ɗon murtira yi'am ɗuɗɗum (Postpartum Hemorrhage) haa o somi, o ɗon nana gilol.

Rewugo ɓandu maako bee hakkilo ngam hisgo mo diga masiibo maide ɗon mari haaje sosai joni.

question: debbo do danyi ha sibiti mai dan labbi jego ko sali o wadi sibiti man be gorgo mako ha o danyi bingel mordo labbi jego moyowardi be mako jonta dada man wadi bayani du o heriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo e tati yahugo sappo e nayi ko sali o wi bo o donno hokka mo lekki damba hiddeko dojjugo man fudda o wi dojjere man halli on daga ki'a balde tati ko fuddi amma har durti o wi de o musinimo fu odon hokkamo lekki diyam je nder gora je be sorata je do jogo do je o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara o wi daga keya do jogoman turti je har yotti bingel man wala wawan fofa be boddum gidami am sosai bana bofde man do ta'a on do yaha dow do je palace kala wakkati fu be hultiri hanjum wadi be waddi musibiti meden jotta emol am hado hanjum on min wawan min hokka debbo do ko vallata mo be bingel do ha sare na larugo no pofde mako ta'ata be dojjere do min vindina be lekki dojjugo na ko'en wadda goje goje dow bingel man yiddeko min hokkamo lekki ko bate

Debbo do danyi ha sibiti meden lebbi jego ko saali. Owari sibiti man beh gorko mako haa o danyi bingel mardo lebbi jego mo be wardi beh mako jonta .
Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.

Ovi de o musini mo fu, odo hokka mo lekki diyam jeh der gora- jeh be sorrata jeh dojjugo do- jeh o dingi hokkugo bingel man do yara.
Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.
Bana pofde man to ta’a on do yaha dau jippa les kala wakkati fu.

model_answer:
Bingel laɓɓi joweego ɗo ɗon nder masiibo mawngo ɗon pofɗe (severe pneumonia), haandi o nasta sibiti jottajotta, ta o hooti saare sam.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Nyawu ɗo waɗi ɓingel ma wi'etee "giri zazzabi" (febrile convulsions), ɗum ɗon heɓa ɓikkon ngam gulɗum ɓandu mum ɓuri heddo. 

Sawan ɗum fuɗɗi, wallin ɓingel man ha sengo booɗɗum, taa watta kowonye ko juuɗe ma nder hunduko maako sam ngam o fofa. 

Koocaa leppungol ndiyam ɓulɗum (lukewarm water) a fofta ɓandu maako ngam gulɗum man ɓusta, ammaa taa sudda mo bee limse gulɗe. 

Yahdu bee ɓingel man asibiti law ngam heɓugo safareeji mawnuɗi bee tingu goonga ko waddani mo zazzabi man bana zazzabi masassa (malaria). 

Taa huutru laabi aadaaji ɓonnooji bana simmugo ko guldinki, ammaa jokka hokkugo mo lekki ɓustugo gulɗum (paracetamol) wande a laari zazzabi fuɗɗi.

model_answer:
Rufugo iyam sembe ɓawo danyugo (Postpartum Hemorrhage) ɗon saabe reedu ufaayi (uterine atony), luttaano danyom (retained placenta), barmugo, ko boo so ɓiɓɓe ɗiɗo ɗon ha nder reedu. 

Pekkee mo batal *Oxytocin* (IU 10) haa korlal walla nukkonee mo kwayaaji *Misoprostol* (800mcg) haa rubuɗu ngam darna iyam ɗam bee ufungo reedu nden. 

Waɗanee mo masaaji (uterine massage) bee juuɗe haa reedu ngam nden ufoo, bo laree to danyom timmi yautugo bee kadi to danyugo man barmni mo. 

Peeɗee mo ɗon e ɗon riga iyam (IV fluids) bana *Normal Saline* bee jaawɗum ngam sembe maako koɗo rufi iyam. 

To iyam ɗam salaayi darnugo, njeehee mo asibiti manga (referral) jooni-jooni ngam heɓugo kuɗol walla iyam to ɗon haaje.

Dada man toh ummini bingel man darni, odo wawa nana no berde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata. Gam bannin, danugo beh jamma do yarna bingel man bone. Oyidi o anda ko wadi dojjugo man fuddi, ko waddi ta’ol pofde man, dende bo o anda hedi o wawata vallugo. Emol am hoda hanjum on: dume on wawata wadda dojjere beh ta’ol pofde do, banda ma beh jamma? Ɗojjugo ɓingel e jamma, fofugo no sattata/wheezing, walla ɓerde/hondu no “fiyata” no wa’i alama ɗum waawii wonde **ciwon huhu (pneumonia), bronchiolitis, asma/wheezing, walla infection**—ɗum waɗi ɓe **yahdu asibiti hannde**.  
So tawii ɓingel no fofata jaasi, gite/leppe no ɗuɗɗi, hondu no naata, o waawataa muynude/yarude, o ɗo yaha blue, walla o ɗo ɗaɓɓita—**a yahdu emergency jooni**.  
Ko ɓe waawi waɗde galle: darna mo ɗooɗɗum, laɓɓina hanci makko e ruwan gishiri/saline, hokku mo nono/ruwa seeɗa-seeɗa, teeɓtu hitaande; **hoto hokku maganin ɗojjugo, antibiotics, walla maganin gargajiya** tawa likita yi’aali.  
Likita maa nana huhu makko, lakkita oxygen/temperature, maa waɗu test malaria/pneumonia so ena sokli, ɗum maa hollu ko waɗi ɗojjugo.  
Saboda o ɗo ɗojja sosai e jamma e fofugo no sattata, **hakkunde ko yahdu asibiti, hoto foti ɗon waɗde tan galle**.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Ko ɗum wayi no **ɓingel ngel waɗi hirdude/convulsion**, ɗum ena waawi jeyaa e **paɗe (fever) sabu malaria, meningitis walla infekshin goɗɗo**, tee ko ɗum **ko ɗoƴƴum ngam ɓingel**.  
Awa, yo ɓe **nawru ngel ɗo wuro dokita/hospital jooni**, ngam ɓe ƴeewto paɗe, malaria, sukaru, meningitis, e waɗa magani mo haani.  
So hirdude ngude arii, **woppu ngel e leydi/ɓernde, suturo hoore, hoto a naatnu hay huunde e hunduko, hoto a waɗu sabulu/gargajiya walla maganin gargajiya**, ngam ɗum ena waawi bonnude walla ngel moƴƴaaɗa.

To ɓingel ɗon doccugo/kuffugo kono ina waawi fofa walla woyde, woppu mo o doccu, hoto naatnu junngo maa e hunduko.  
To o waawataa fofa, woyde walla doccugo, ɗum gaggawa: waɗu mo yeeso yeeso, hokku mo daddol e daker hakkunde balɗe juuɗe laabi 5.  
So haɗaare ronkii, ɓingel tokooso hokku “chest thrusts” laabi 5; ɓingel mawɗo ngam hitaande 1, waɗu abdominal thrusts.  
Jokku ɗum haa huunde nde o waɗi yaltu walla o fuɗɗi fofa; so o heltii/wala fofa, fuɗɗu CPR, e noddu taimako, yaa asibiti gaggawa.  
Ɓe waɗu ɗum ngam haɗaare ɗon waawi haɓɓude ɗatal fowde, ɗum ko haɗari seɗa.

question: inde am mrs akinleye bawo lebbi didi ko sali do mi hirliti ni gorko am fofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam be odo isra akai akai banda ma odo babel sollaji ko habe sa'ata hunde wodo isra akai akai ni bo fofugo daidai o hukka mo bone fofugo mako do wada ta'a be odo isra to odo bebbel curde ko sollaji wodi koji min wadata heba hefta ko wadata dottugo do be isrugo ko jonde ha pellel mari sollaji dow don waddata dum ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe'a irin lekki toi don o naftirta fofugo mako hota dai dai be kuma o wawan o jo da belɗum ko ha uwonifu
reference:
Inde am Mrs Akinleye, bawo lebbi didi ko saali do, mi hirliti nii gorko am, foofugo mako da daidai ba sam sam. Be odo isla akai akai , bandam odo babel sollaji ko ha be saa ta hunde. Odo isla akai akai ni bo foofugo dai dai do hokka mo bone. Foofugo mako do wada ta’a be odo isla to odoo pellel churde ko sollaaji. Wodi goji min wadata heba hefta ko waddata hojjugo do be islugo? Ko joode ha pelel mari sollaaji do waddata dum, ko bandu mako don chanjata wadata dum fe’a?
Irin lekki toi don o naftirita, foofugo mako hoota daidai be kuma owaawan ojooda peldum ko ha o woni fuu?
model_answer:
Mrs Akinleye, ɗee alamooji ɗi njiɗi hollirde sukkara (diabetes), ko ciwon prostate/UTI walla matsala koda, sabu isrugo ɗuuɗde, ɗomɗe/koji, waylugol bandu e laawol gorko.  
On ƴahde asibiti seeɗa ngam a waɗana mo gwajin blood sugar, fitsari, BP, koda, e binciken prostate.  
To o heɓii bone tuma isrugo, jammu, ɗimmere, jiiɓde, ko jone ngeɗe, ɗum ko emergency—ƴahee asibiti jooni.  
Hoto o huutoro “maganin ƙarfi” walla lekki ɗe a soodii e kasuwa, sabu ɗi mbaawi bonnude ɓernde e BP.  
Lekki fotde waɗde ɗum fota ɗum se dokita waɗi bayan gwaje-gwaje.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer:
Ɗum ena waawi wonde **dimbugo zazzabi (febrile convulsion)**, kono e na waɗi sabu **malaria, infection nder heɓɓere/meningitis**, walla nyawu goɗɗo.  
Soɗɗu ɓinngel ɗo leydi, waɗ ɗum e **ɓernde/ɓalli mako**, ittude huunde kala ɗo waawi lorɓude ɗum, **a hoto waɗ huunde nder hunduko** walla njoggo jungo/teede mako.  
So dimbugo ɗum ɓuri **mintina 5**, walla ɗum maɓɓi ɗum, walla ɓinngel walaa hakkilo caggal ɗum—**yaadu daɗi asibiti gila jooni**.  
Ko fii nder Nigeria malaria ena waɗi ɗum heewi, ɓinngel ɗo waɗan **test malaria** e ɗaɓɓude magani ɗo likita.  
A hoto hokku magani zazzabi walla ganye tan ko alaa likita yi’i ɓinngel ɗo.

question: debbo fere danyi keccel har asibiti amin fajiri do danyugo mai hokkaimo bone sam o danyi wala damuwa neɓai sam bawo danyi min lari leppol min wanni mo bulli sofni be iyam bawo minti seɗɗa debbo do naftiri be leppol fere kanjum mai fu hebbini be iyam neɓai sam debbo fuɗɗi nanugo wala sembe bo iyam mai don rufa sosai sali darugo dume on waddata rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo ɗume watta darna iyam mai ko wawan lata ɓingel fere ɗon ha nder redu debbo ɗo ɗume on waddi rufugo iyam sembe darata ɗo ba je deɓɓo ɗo ɗume min wawata min wanna deɓɓo ɗo irin batal ko lekki toi naftirta deɓɓo ɗo be min tura deɓɓo ɗo siɓiti manga ko ɗon ko min wawata min wanna debbo ɗo je darnata iyam mai
reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. Dume don waddata rufugo eyam bawo dayugo ? Dime watta darna eyam mai? Ko wawan laata bingel fere don ha der reedu debbo do? Dume don waddi rufugo eyam sembe darata do ba je debbo do? Dume min wawata min wanna debbo do, eyam mai dara? Irin baatal ko lekki toi naftirint debbo do , be min tura debbo do sibiti manga na , ko don ko min wawata min wanna debbo do je darnata eyam mai?
model_answer:
Debbo ɗo ena woodi **rufugo iyam ɓawo danyugo (post‑partum haemorrhage)**, ɗum hatara: ko reedu salii ɓeewde, **placenta/leɓɓol walla ragowar ɗum heddii**, fere laawol jibinaa, ko ɓingel goɗɗel nder reedu—scan/palpation ina walla ɗum.  
Jooni noddee ballal, ɗaɓɓee BP/pulse, waɗee **IV line ɗiɗi**, hokkee Normal saline/Ringer, ɗaɓɓee/cross‑match iyam, waɗee **massaji reedu** e catheter fitsari.  
Hokkee **oxytocin 10 IU IM/IV slow**, jokkondir 20–40 IU e drip; si wala, hokkee **misoprostol 800 mcg** nder ɗemngal walla rectal, e **tranexamic acid 1 g IV**.  
Ƴeewtee placenta si heɓɓinii; si ragowar heddii, yaltinee aseptic si on ngoodi gandal, fere laawol jibinaa soodi.  
Si iyam salii darugo, debbo sembe ɗon lutta, walla BP low—**turree mo siɓiti manga gila jooni** tare e drip/oxytocin ɗon jokka, hoto ɗon ɗeɓa lokaci.

question: inde am titilola daga keya ɓandu ɓingel am ɗo wuli o ɗo fita diwna ɓingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam ɗo nandama bana dande ɓingel man wuitata wailutuggo wite wore ɓingel man wawata maɓɓutugo ɗumejum on wawata woda zazzaɓi ɗo beko bo haɗata dande mako wailutuggo gwal toi hande mi wanna mo heɓa mi anda sababu zazzaɓi man be ko haɗata dande mako wailutuggo jawabu toi bo ɓe yecce tamen je kowanni darɓan duɓɓingarman je waddata zazzaɓi be kora ta dade mako wailutuggo
reference:
Inde am Titilola. Daga keya, bandu bingel am do wuli, odo fiita diwna.
Bingel man wala wawa wailita dande mako sam. Do nanda ma bana dande bingel metata wailutuggo. Gite wore bingel man wawata mabbutuggo. Dumejum on wawata wadda zazzabi doh beh bo ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Gwal toi handi mi wanna mo heba mi anda sababu zazzabi man beh ko hadata dande mako wailutuggo? Jawabu toi beh yeccata men jeh ko woni der bandu bingel man jeh waddata zazzabi beh ko hadata dade mako wailutuggo?
model_answer:
Titilola, ɓingel mo zazzaɓi e dande mako ɗo taƴi/walata wailude, ɗum ko **alama haɗari**—ina foti wonde **meningitis** walla **malaria tiiɗɗo**, ɗum ina waawi waraade ɓingel.  
**Yahdu mo asibiti jooni-jooni** ngam moƴƴinde: ina sokli ƴeewtere, test ɗooɗi, e allura magani no ceftriaxone/antimalarial so doktoro yiɗi.  
So aɗa ɗaɓɓa dow laawol, hokku **paracetamol** ngam ɗowtude zazzaɓi, wuurnu ɓandu mako e ndiyam lewru, kono **hoto waɗu aspirin/hoto fuɗɗo antibiotics e suudu**.  
So o heɓii faints, kakkilannde, jooni-jooni yarfugol, wala o waawaa njarugol/nyaamugol—ɗum ko gollal gorko: yahdu emergency ɗoon.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer:
Ɗum ko alamaaji haɗari: rufugo ndiyam no heewi, sembe ɗaiɗai, juuɗe/kosɗe ɓe ɓeyɗi ɓuuɓi, ɗum na hollira ɓingel ngel na waɗi “dehydration” walla infection/malaria.  
Likita yo ƴeewto ɓandu, zafin jiki, sukari jini, gwaji malaria, electrolytes, e ko ndiyam ɓandu mum wayi.  
So dehydration na heewi, ɓingel ɗum waɗan “drip” walla ORS seeɗa-seeɗa, e magani ɗarnata rufugo ko likita hokki; haɗa nono/ɗaɗi ɗum woodi.  
Hoto lekki gida walla antibiotics tawa likita yamiraani, sabu ɗum waawi ɓeydude haɗari.  
Ko o woni asibiti ɗum ko feewi; ɓe waɗa ko haani, sembe mako maa artirto so ndiyam e sabu ɗum heɓii.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer:
Ɓingel lewru 3 tawa o woni e tari/keccel haa o waawataa ɗaanugo walla muynugo no feewi, ko haɗum waɗi a yahdu mo to asibiti jooni, ngam ɓiɓɓe ɗiɗi no mbaawi yahde e pneumonia/bronchiolitis ko whooping cough.  
Ko ena waawi wonde hendu/cattarh, amma alamu hasare ko: hendu yaawi, ɓernde/ɓoggi mum na waɗa “gimɗol”, o salii muynugo, o hutti kala ko o yari, nguleendi, o laaɓaani/loyyi, konngi bula, walla o waɗi fits.  
Hoto hokku mo syrup tari walla lekki defa-jira; ena mbaawi waɗude bonannde e ɓingel tokosel.  
A waawi waɗude drop ruwa gishiri na hanci, a momta keccel no feewi, a hokku nono seeɗa-seeɗa ɗooɗi ɗum, a jogii mo yeeso ɓawo muynugol, tee a haɗa duumol/sigaare/ƙura.  
Likita yo nana hendu mum, yo ƴeewa ko o sokli oxygen, nebulization walla antibiotic; ɗum ɓuri sellude.

question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam fewɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer: Ɗii alamaraaji (hirlitugo, kecca, e ndiyam yaltugo) ɗon holla wonde ɓingel ngel ɗon heɓa tampere mawnde e fofugo (neonatal respiratory distress), waawi wonde sabu rafi (sepsis) malla ŋakkere oksijin haa kwakwalwa (HIE). A haani nawgo ngel safrirde mawnde (NICU) yaake ngam wallitugo fofugo bee masiin (ventilator) nder li'al ngal, nden kokkugo ngel oksijin ngam hisnugo ngel. Daktajo dole kokka ngel safaaraaji nder ɗaɗi (antibiotics) ngam haɓɓugo rafiiji, nden kokka ngel surfactant to ngel heɓaama yeeso wakkati (premature) ngam wallitugo fofugo. Dojjugo (seizures) ngon haani safiree bee safaaraaji bana phenobarbital, nden nguleeki ɓanndu e suukara ɗiiyam haani reenee haa laabi. Ɗum woni dille mawɗe (emergency) ɗe kaani safaara ceɓaɗum, ngam maajum on nawta ngel to safrirde mawnde to daktajo mo anndini e safrugo ɓiɓɓe ɓesngu woni.

question: mi yari sobajo am reduje mo ɗuɓi mako sappo e jetati ngam o nasti ɗayugo bo wakkati waɗi dey min yotti sibiti may ɓe hosi mo ɓe goddi mo ko handi fu ɓe tawi sembe iyam mako wa'i ɓe waɗi ko handi ni fu ɓe waɗa o dow der daƴugo o ɗon ni har ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi gorko mako dayai likita en sowri debbo mai o jaba ɓe wanna mo siyas gam o dow der daƴugo ɗo neeɓi sobajo am sali sam o fi way o yiɗi dayugo ɓaroɓe ibrani'en dayata daga ɓawo o dayi ɓingel ɓawo awa sappo e ɗiɗi o ɗo nder dayugo o dayi ɓingel debbo e jam kuma min yettore allah amma ko hilni am ɓingel ɗo wala fofa boɗɗum ɓe dimbi akai akai mari wuji ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo o hokki ni amma fofugo wartai dei dei har jotta ɓe yawi ɓe hokki mo oxygen likita useni ɓingel ɗo hisan na be to o hisi o warta ɓingel mo wodi na foori na
reference:
Mi yari sobaajo am reduujo , mo duubi mako sappo e je tati, gam o nasti dayugo bo wakati wadi . Dai min yotti sibiti mai, be hosimo bo begodimo ko haadi fu, be tawi sembe eyam mako va’e. De bawadi ko haadini fu be wada . Odo der dayugo. Odon nii har bawo awa sappo e didi. Gorko mako dayai, likita en sauri debbo mai ojaba be wanna mo CS, gam odo der dayugo do neebi .
Sobajo am salli sam , ovi wai oyidi dayugo ba roobe ibrani’en dayata .
Dagabawo o dayi bingel, bawo awaa sappo e didi o do der dayugo. Odayi bingel debbo e jamun, kuma minyettore Allah. Amma ko hilni amin bingel do wala foofa boddum. Be dimbi akai akai, marri , wugi bandu bingel do. Owooki ni amma foofugo warta deedai har jotta.
Be yawi be hokkimo oksijin.
Likita, Useni, bingel do hisan na? Be to o hisi, o wartan bingel mo woodi naafoore na?
model_answer: Miɗo faama hal maa, ɓingel ngel wondi e rafi waasde heɓde fofa (birth asphyxia) e ooleeki ɓanndu (jaundice) sabu dayugo ngoo ɓooyi e rafi ɓeydaare ƴiiƴam yummiriiwo. Fofa mo ngel heɓaayi e wakkati dayugo ɗon bonna kwakwalwa maggel, ɗum waɗi ngel dimbataako walla fofataa no haanirta, tawi ooleeki ɓanndu ndee ɗon holla ɓanndu ngel waawaa laɓɓinde ƴiiƴam. Ko haani jooni, ɓingel ngel haani wonde e suudu toppitiingu sukkaɓe (NICU) ngam heɓde fofa (oxygen), lekki laɓɓinoowu ooleeki (phototherapy), e toppitigo keeringo. Likita o wi'i ngel waawaa wontude mo wodi foori sabu kwakwalwa maggel waawaa heɓde caɗeele (HIE) gila ngel woni e reedu sabu ɗaɓɓitaare dayugo. Tiiɗno waɗu du'aa, kono ɗaɓɓee ballal annduɓe sukkaɓe (pediatricians) ngam ƴeewde no kwakwalwa ngel e ooleeki ɓanndu ndee wallirta e yontere garooje.

question: dada fere hakkili layi ɓingel mun do dojja jey balɗe arindiri kam o tamma pewol on billata ɓerde ɓingel man nden bo accan mo amma bo dojjugo man ustai ɓingel man ɗo umma kala jamma fu ngam dojjara man wakkati go kamma ɓingel man ɗo habda bana o wala wawa fofa be boɗɗum dada man to ummini ɓingel man darni o ɗo wawa nana no ɓerde mako fiyata wakkati o fofata ngam bannin ɗanugo be jamma ɗo yarna ɓingel man bone nde ɓingel man ɗojji sosai hagagiri mo fofugo be boɗɗum nder jamma jango man dada man tasi gewugo asibiti o yiɗi o nana ko waɗi ɗojjugo man fuɗɗi ko waɗi tawugo bo fuɗɗe man dende bo o anda hedi o wawata wallugo emol am ha ɗo kanjum on ɗumi on wawata wadda ɗojjere be ta'ol pofɗe ɗo banda ma be jamma kuje kalluɗum toi e handi ɓe hakkila be man to ɓingel man o dojja kujeji toi handi ɓe hakkila be man gam o usta ko haɗa dojjugo man
reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel wala nder hakkilo tee mayi nonnon, ɗum holli nyawu mawngu bana zazzabi mawngu, nyawu ƴiiƴam (sepsis), ko meningitis, ngam cille ɗon ɲama ɓe ɗiɗo fuu. Zazzabi yadataa e nonnon, ammaa ɓingel ngel waawi heɓugo ɗum diga cille ko nyawu goɗɗo ɗon ƴakka ngel. A foti doggo yaha suudu nyaworde (hospital) jooni-jooni, ngam ɓingel maygo nonnon e walaago nder hakkilo ɗon kawra e maayde to a sakkiti. Nde a ɗon yaha, ɓillu ɓingel ngel ngam ngel wula, taa a ƴetta nonnon a nyaama ngel e cokori to ngel waawaa ɗaɓɓugo. Nder suudu nyaworde, likitaaji ƴeewat suukara ngel, ɓe ƴeewat zazzabi, ɓe kokka ngel leɗɗe e ruwam nder ɓanndu (IV) ngam danda ngel.

reference: Debbo fere dayi chekkel ha sibiti amin fajiri do. Dayugo mai hokkai mo bone sam, odayi wala damuwa. Nebai sam bawo o dayi min laari leppol min wanni mo buli, sofni be eyam.  Bawo minti sedda debbo do naftiri be leppol fere, kanjum mai fu hebbini be eyam. Nebai sam debbo fuddi nanugo owala sembe bo eyam mai do rufa sosai sali darugo. model_answer: Rufugo iyam sembe ɓawo danyugo ɓuri heɓugo sabu leppol fassiti (uterine atony) sabu danyugo neɓai, amma sai on ƴeewa ko ɓingel fere walla tara (placenta) heddii, wala toɓɓe tayii. On ndarna iyam man bee ɓattugo leppol, hokkugo mo lekki Oxytocin (wala Misoprostol) e Tranexamic Acid (TXA) nder ɓanndu (IV). On njokka hokkugo mo iyam ruwa (IV fluids) ngam sembe makko, on ɓilla mo NASG to o woodi, nden on ƴeewa ko o haaji iyam yimɓe (blood transfusion). To iyam on darataa, wala asibiti mon walaa iyam yimɓe, sai on tura mo asibiti manga law, har on njokka ɓattugo leppol har laawol. Danyugo neɓai watta leppol fassita ɗum waddi rufugo iyam sembe, sai on ɗaɓɓita ballal law ngam hisnugo rayuwa debbo ɗo.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Bo odo sommi sommi ni sosai bo wala ko o waawata wadugo. Kanjum wadi o waddimo sibiti heba likita laara bandu mako. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Ɓingel ngel ɗo heɓi rafi ɓanndu (neonatal sepsis) e caɗeele ƴiiƴam (shock) waɗi ɓanndu mako fu ɗo fewi, ɗum waɗi min ɗo kokka mo iyam nder ɗaɗi (IV fluids) e lekki antibiotics ngam wallitugo ƴiiƴam mako e rufugo iyam. Likita ɗo lara ɓanndu mako ngam anndugo ko ƴeƴe (kidneys) mako ɗo golla no haandi, nden o hokka mo lekki ngam wargugo rafi e wallitugo ɓanndu mako heɓugo sembe. A foti ɓillugo ɓingel mako nonon ko ɓuri heewugo ngam nonon ɗo wallita ɓingel heɓugo iyam e sembe, bo a ɗon suttura mo no haandi ngam o wula. Nder asibiti, min ɗon lura e rufugo iyam mako e nguleeki ɓanndu mako fu, min kuutortoo sutturgol ɓingel e ɓanndu yumma (Kangaroo care) ngam ɓeydugo nguleeki e sembe mako. Nde a hokki mo lekki je likita vindini, a ɗon reena mo yeeso nguleeki, ɓingel mako ɗon heɓa cellal nden o rufa iyam no haandi.

question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Lamnɗol am: ko watata ɓingel peetel taari sosay be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum? Waawan waɗa taari be boneeɗe foofugo man alamu huttu? Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Tari jemma be wokan caggal tari ha ɓingel lewru jetati ɗon holla wonde o mari "pertussis" (tari kikii'e), ko "reflux" (ruɗam reedu artugo), ko kuuje ɓawo ɗe ngalaa cellal. To o daanii, kuuje ɓawo ko ruɗam reedu ɗon saama ha ɗaɗol, ɗum ɗon ummina mo, waɗa tari, haɗa mo fofugo, sali mo nyaamugo. Ngam hasare arannde, ɓam hoore mako seeɗa to o ɗon daana, hokka mo noni seeɗa-seeɗa ko ɗuuɗi laabi, huutoro ruɗam lamɗam (saline) ngam laaɓna kuuje ɓawo mako. Taa hokku mo lekki tari (cough syrups) e hoore mako, amma a yaha likita gam o heɓa lekki "antibiotics" ko lekki uddita ɓanndu to ko tari kikii'e ko "asthma". Yaaɗugo likita ɗon haani sosai ngam likita man suɓa lekki goonga ki ɗon safrata ɗume woni haddi tari man, ɗum walla ɓingel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma.

reference:
Dada fere hakkili lari bingel mum do dojja jeh balde.
Arindere kam, o tamma pewol on billata berde bingel man, den bo accan mo.

model_answer: Ɓingel ma on no e kulol mawol sabu dojjugo mum haa ɓurti be fofugo hawti be ɓerde mum no ɓilla ko maandeeji nifumoniya (pneumonia) walla paludeeni (malaria) tiiɗɗum. reference: Rawaandu ngati ɓingel ɓanɗam. Duɓi mako je ɗiɗi. De rawaandu mai gati mo, eyehi ha gargajiya, goɗɗo gargajiya ta'i babal mai se wati lekki fere inde majum 'aporo'. Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? model_answer: Sababu rafi ɓingel ɗan ko ɓutti e namputure (gastroenteritis) walla surako (malaria) mo addi ɗum yoorugo ɓandu (dehydration). Ha asibiti, aɗa foti ƴeƴtugo ƴiiƴam ngam surako, ƴeƴtugo namputure, e ƴeƴtugo no ɓandu ɗan yooriri. Ngam wutandu, ɓuri himmugo ko ɓeydugo ndiyam e ɓandu huwtorgol ORS walla ndiyam asibiti (IV fluids) ngam ɗan heɓta semmbe. So surako woodi, a rokkat ɗum lekki ACT, te a rokkat ɗum zinc ngam taƴugo ɓutti e namputure. Ɓingel ɗan foti ɗowteede no feewi ha asibiti haa rafi ɗan taƴi.

model_answer: Hakkiilu mon ko huunde moƴƴere, sabu dillugol ɓanndu makko e ɗaɓɓugol ɲaamdu ina hollda wonde omo wondi e rafi ƴarugol walla muɗo (substance withdrawal) tiiɗɗo. So neɗɗo accii yarugol walla huunde woɗnde tawa ɓanndu makko ina dilla, ɗum ina waawi addude caɗeele mawɗe walla maayde so ƴeewtaaka. question: dada ɓingel fere ɗo dami hala keccel mako mo mari lewru jetati be nange ɓingel mai fijol boɗɗum amma to jemma waɗi sai o fuɗɗa tarihi tarihi mai ɗo ummina keccel man diga ɗoiɗi mako bo keccel mai wokan diga ɓawo ha iri kala jemma ɗo dada mai lari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be lau bo ɗo habda fofa mai ma dada mai kasi ɗanugo gam o hutiri defa jira waɗi dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musnugo bo o sali ficcugo no o wowi sai o yari keccel mayi ha likita gam o yiɗi o anda ɗume on haddi sittatari man bo ko waɗi o ɗo fofa be bone bo o anda iri kala lekki toye wannata ɓingel man lamɗol am kowatata ɓingel petel tari sosai be jemma bo haɗa ɓingel man fofugo boɗɗum wawan waɗa tari be bone ɗi fofugo man alamu huttu ɗume be ɗume e wawata waɗugo hasare heɓa keccel man ɗana boɗɗum jemma
reference: Daada ɓingel fere ɗo daami hala kechel mako mo mari lewru jetati. Be naange, ɓingel mai fijan boɗɗum, amma to jemma waɗi se o fuɗɗa tari. Tari mai ɗo ommina kechel man diga ɗoiɗi mako, bo kechel mai wokan diga ɓawo. Ha iri kala jemma doh, dada mai laari ɓingel man ɗo fofa be law bo oɗo habda fofa mai ma. Dada mai kaasi ɗaanugo gam o hulturi. De fajira waɗi, dada mai hakkili lari ɓingel mai sali musunugo bo o sali fijugo no ovowi, se oyaari kechel ha likita gam oyiɗi o anda ɗume on haddisitta tari man bo ko waɗi oɗo fofa be bone bo o'anda iri kala lekki toi ewannata ɓingel man. Ɗume be ɗume ewaawata waɗugo ha saare heɓa kechel man ɗaana boɗɗum jemma?
model_answer: Ko haddi sittatari, fofa be lau, fijol boɗɗum, e sali musnugo ɗo keccel man ko alamuuji hatte mawɗi holluɗi wonde ɓingel man mari rafi mawɗo wa pneumonia, malaria tiiɗɗo, walla rafi ɗon nooda ɓanndu. A foti yarbugo keccel man law law ha opitaal walla kliniik ɓurɗo ɓadugo ma gam o heɓa piillooji, lekki malaria, e oksijen. Si a leeliima, rafi on no wawa warugo keccel man, ɗum waɗi yarbugo makko law ko huunde wootere ɓurnde himmugo.
